b3e80bd0.title: Senior Consultant | Database Administrator | Delhi | Operations, Industry & Domain Solutions | DigiG
b3e80bd0.description:
**Job Description**

  

**Job Title:** Database Architect (DBA)

**Location:** Delhi

**Experience Level:** 8+ Years

* Experience in database architecture, design and administration across relational and non-relational systems, ETL pipelines, data governance frameworks and integration with heterogeneous Government and third-party data sources.

* Demonstrated experience in developing master data management systems, exporter–importer datasets, data validation and enrichment protocols, and building scalable, secure database environments supporting analytics, dashboards and AI/ML-driven matchmaking, scoring and prioritisation workflows.

**Education Qualifications:** BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech

  

**Job Role**

8 years in database design, optimization, backup strategies, security, and administration of databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server.

  

**Responsibilities:**

Looking for highly skilled Database Architect (DBA) with deep expertise in PostgreSQL to design, manage, and optimize our database infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability of PostgreSQL databases. This role involves working closely with development teams to design database solutions that meet both application requirements and best practices for data management and security.

  

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Design, implement, and manage high-performance, scalable PostgreSQL database systems.

* Optimize database performance through indexing, query tuning, and other optimization techniques.

* Ensure data integrity, security, and disaster recovery through effective backup strategies, replication, and failover mechanisms.

* Monitor database performance and proactively resolve performance bottlenecks.

* Implement best practices for database architecture, including partitioning, sharing, and clustering.

* Perform regular database health checks, patching, and version upgrades.

* Manage users, roles, and database access permissions to ensure data security.

* Troubleshoot database issues and provide timely resolution.

* Stay updated with the latest PostgreSQL features and advancements to improve database performance and scalability

* Proven experience as a Database Architect or DBA, with expertise in PostgreSQL.

* Strong proficiency in designing and optimizing PostgreSQL databases.

* Experience with database replication, partitioning, clustering, and sharding.

* Proficiency in query tuning, performance optimization, and indexing strategies.

* Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL-specific features such as PL/pgSQL, triggers, and stored procedures.

* Experience with PostgreSQL backup and restore processes, including logical and physical backups.

* Knowledge of database monitoring tools and techniques

* Experience with database migration strategies and tools

8e9e8103.title: Director Cloud Solution Architect
8e9e8103.description:
**Overview**

The Customer Success Unit brings together deep technical expertise and customer success leadership to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and realize value from their Microsoft investments. Data and AI sit at the center of every organization's transformation, and our customers are looking to Microsoft to help them modernize their data estates, unlock insights, and build secure, responsible, production-grade AI solutions.

As the Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) Manager – Data & AI, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Cloud Solution Architects who help customers and partners design, deploy, and scale solutions across Microsoft's Data & AI portfolio — including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, Power BI, Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry), Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and agentic AI solutions. You will guide the team in translating customer business challenges into data and AI architectures, removing technical blockers, driving operational readiness, accelerating consumption and usage growth, and delivering solutions aligned with Microsoft methodologies and proven practices.

This opportunity will allow you to strengthen your people leadership, deepen your expertise in data platforms and AI, and help scale repeatable Data & AI patterns and best practices across a diverse portfolio of strategic customers.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

 **Responsibilities**

Business Impact

* Coaches the team on operating to required operational excellence and proven practice standards across all engagement stages, activities, and tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, consumption tracking, time tracking).

* Leads the team in orchestrating across Microsoft account teams, specialists, partners, and customer teams to deliver on-strategy Data & AI outcomes and increase customer and partner satisfaction.

* Oversees the team in anticipating and managing business and technical risks for data and AI workloads — including data quality, data governance, model performance, cost, and Responsible AI considerations — applying governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize risk.

* Leads the team in delivering solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., value-based deliverables [VBDs], architecture design sessions, technical validation, training), ensuring proven patterns are followed so customers are operationally ready to run data and AI workloads in production.

* Coaches the team on guiding customers toward well-architected (secure, resilient, governed, AI-ready), cost- and performance-optimized data platforms and AI solutions that increase retention and expansion opportunities.

* Drives the team to proactively identify cross-solution opportunities for Data & AI consumption, usage, and Unified expansion (including Enhanced Solutions) — such as data estate modernization, analytics migration to Microsoft Fabric, generative AI and agentic applications, and Copilot extensibility — based on clear business value to the customer.

* Guides the team on articulating the value of Unified and partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with the right Data & AI services. Leads feedback to the Unified Delivery team on Data & AI VBDs to refine and further develop content.

* Leverages change management proven practices (or engages the change management team) to help customers drive long-term organizational adoption of data and AI solutions, including data literacy and AI adoption.

* Drives the team on anticipating, identifying, escalating, and mitigating blockers — such as data readiness, platform limits, capacity and quota, security reviews, and skills gaps — to accelerate deployment, value realization, and consumption.

* Leads the team to capture opportunities in appropriate systems and tools, working collaboratively across the organization in alignment with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.

Customer Centricity

* Coaches the team to focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery and a seamless, connected customer experience; drives realization of customer conditions of success.

* Leads the team in anticipating and resolving customer dissatisfaction through customer confidence calls, and in executing strategies to improve experience, value realization, and speed of transformation.

* Supports the team in translating customer business problems into Data & AI solutions aligned with Microsoft's platform strategy — explaining how they meet business outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals through proofs of concept, minimum viable products (MVPs), and rapid prototypes, relative to competitive offerings.

* Coaches the team on building trusted relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C-suite — including Chief Data Officers (CDOs), Chief Data & Analytics Officers, Chief AI Officers, CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs — and bridging understanding between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs).

* Elevates engagements with CXO stakeholders on data governance, data privacy, security, compliance, and Responsible AI requirements, engaging additional subject matter experts where deeper expertise is required.

* Leads the team in acting as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and technical input with Engineering, Product, and internal communities. Coaches the team on identifying patterns across customers to develop actionable insights and on presenting business cases that influence product roadmaps and bug-fix prioritization.

Partner Specialization

* Actively orchestrates initiatives, leveraging an expansive knowledge of the Data & AI partner ecosystem to select and champion the most qualified partners for complex customer projects.

* Collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) stakeholders and Partner Technology Specialist (PTS) leadership to translate Data & AI opportunities into action, fostering technical and solution coherence across Microsoft partner and sales ecosystems.

* Concentrates on identifying and prioritizing opportunities that align with the organization's strategic revenue and consumption goals, directing partner and sales support through proofs of concept and technical pre-sales guidance.

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

* Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

* Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

* Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual's capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Technical Leadership

* Leads the team in identifying gaps through delivery and connecting patterns across business and technology areas to drive improvements to products, intellectual property (IP), and practices that enable Data & AI solutions to scale across customers.

* Coaches the team on contributing to Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Cloud Adoption Framework for data and AI, Well-Architected Framework, Responsible AI Standard).

* Leads the team in contributing to and building reusable IP — reference architectures, accelerators, and solution patterns — especially where no IP exists yet (e.g., generative AI, AI agents, Copilot extensibility, RAG, and real-time intelligence scenarios).

* Enables the team to lead and assemble virtual teams (v-teams) around Data & AI technologies and customer challenges, sharing insights with technical communities across the field using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and the competitive landscape (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud).

* Drives recognition for Microsoft Data & AI solutions by leading and encouraging the team's participation in internal and external events (e.g., Ignite, Build, Fabric Community Conference, Tech Connect, meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons).

* Uses market insights and demand signals to help leadership prioritize up-skilling and accreditations. Drives the team to role-model technical readiness — depth in Data & AI (data engineering, analytics, data science, MLOps/LLMOps, generative and agentic AI) and breadth across CSU priorities such as security, resilience, and AI.

* Ensures team members dedicate time to continuous learning and certification, monitoring progress and providing guidance where appropriate.

 **Qualifications**

Required/Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in data platforms, analytics, AI/machine learning, cloud technologies, technology consulting, software development, solution architecture, and/or practice development; OR equivalent experience.

* 3+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects, consultants, or technical specialist teams.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

* 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with hands-on experience designing and delivering data and AI solutions.

* 6+ years of experience leading technical projects, teams, or functions.

* Strong working knowledge of modern data and AI architectures (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh, real-time analytics, MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents) and Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Power BI, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, and Azure OpenAI.

* Understanding of data governance, security, and Responsible AI principles and tooling (e.g., Microsoft Purview).

* Technical certifications in data and AI (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent).

* 5+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects or consulting practice managers.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

9cb51989.title: Solution Sales - Sr Partner
9cb51989.description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Work with existing and new customers to understand their key initiatives in Consumer Lending and Retail Banking across Marketing, Originations, Customer Management, Personalization, Collections and Fraud. Uncover and discover ways for the FICO Platform to help our customers rapidly develop, deploy, and manage analytics & strategies across the lifecycle that deliver optimal results within articulated constraints. With more than 60 years of stable growth, FICOs world-class Software solutions support smarter decisions for thousands of businesses worldwide. As a Platform Sales - Sr Partner you'll be responsible for educating our customers about the enormous opportunity of empowering business users to leverage the FICO Platform as the ‘brain and central nervous system’ for mission critical decisions that unlock human and analytic capital permitting our customers to achieve their unique potential.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Share expertise and thought leadership in Decisioning, Analytics, & Optimization within Financial Services with the goal of helping our clients leapfrog the competition leveraging FICO’s cutting-edge Platform.
* Build relationships with senior client stakeholders in Business and Technology to gain insights into their most urgent decision management related problems while articulating FICO’s platform capabilities.
* Research and shape potential solution opportunities through collaborative engagement with internal Key Account Managers, Pre-Sales Domain Experts and Pre-Sales Architects to formulate and effectively position solution proposals.
* Ensure clients are delighted with solutions purchased to create win-win relationships that are long-term, expanding, and profitable.
* Collaborate across internal FICO teams including Global Solution Architecture, Product Development, Finance and Professional Services to shape a cohesive sales effort that educates our customers on the tremendous business value the FICO Platform delivers.
* Work with the largest and most advanced Financial Institutions in South East Asia as well as a core set of leaders in the Fintech, Telecommunications, Media, and Entertainment industries.
* Manage sales to quarterly and annual targets, with significant earnings upside when targets are exceeded.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Bachelor’s degree and, or experience developed in work environments.
* Strong track record building relationships and a knack for understanding the client’s industry and business/technology challenges.
* Demonstrated success structuring and selling complex, enterprise software solutions to large clients in financial services/banking a plus.
* Knowledge or experience in Consumer Lending, Credit Risk, Account Management, Retail Banking and Fraud is also a plus.
* Have a deep interest in, and or experience in both the technical and business use of data, behavioral profiles, decision management, orchestration, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Simulation, and Optimization in SaaS offerings.
* Techno-Functional expertise preferred
* A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
* A Passion to work hard under tight deadlines and a pension for thriving in high pressure situations.
* A Collaborative style of working where the strengths of teammates are celebrated and the whole team is greater than the sum of its players.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of business week as we need to know our customers and their aspirations intimately to truly make difference

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

25d57a29.description:
* Works with project team to ensure smooth and efficient implementation and integration between technical and functional system requirements.
* Ability to deliver in faster go-lives using agile methodology
* Ability to lead faster deployments focused on value delivery.
* Works as a functional liaison between Project Team and key customer executives. Has knowledge of either Blue Yonder Demand & Fulfillment, Assortment Planning, Allocation or Category Management Solutions.
* Has working experience of AI/ ML algorithms in supply chain
* Works with all levels of Blue Yonder associates in developing functional specifications, analysis of user needs and testing.
* Participates in business process analysis or design/construction phase of the project that leads to writing functional specifications.
* Works on development of functional specifications for modifications, interfaces, reports, and screens that meet the customers' business objectives and are of sound design.
* Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology.
* Understands how Blue Yonder solutions (Demand, Fulfill, Assortment, Allocation, Assortment Planning, Category Management) can be configured to better facilitate client business processes.
* Escalates issues that may have negative scheduling impact. Always conducts oneself in a professional manner with Blue Yonder customers and internal associates.
* Ensures the security and integrity of corporate assets and intellectual property. Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures

**What You’ll Do**

* Assists Project Managers in planning efforts including detailed project plan task detail (work breakdown structure) based on the specific phase/need of the project
* Communicates and/or supports the business cases to Product Management Group and Product Development regarding specific trends for future product functionality and enhancements.
* Expert in developing / utilizing AI/ ML algorithms in statistical forecasting space
* Working experience of R, python packages
* As required, ability to represent Blue Yonder in industry conferences workshops preferred
* Ability to execute projects single-handedly with high delivery quality
* Facilitates/leads business diagnostics, process analysis and/or design workshops to help flush out as-is and desired to-be solution state and ultimately writes a solution design document to support business requirements
* Leads the writing of functional specifications during the design phase of the project that supports the documented solution design
* Develops functional business process test scripts (step by step instructional how to do) which outline new or updated end-user functional processes supported by the solution design which may include standard application functionality, customized modifications, data interfaces, reports/layouts, … Prepares for and conducts customized end-user training workshops to support application training content outside of base application knowledge / Blue Yonder Certifications
* Is a thought leader in their Product Solution area of focus and is able to apply that knowledge to customer situations
* Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology
* Recognizes and highlights incremental revenue opportunities with existing customers/projects.
* Serves as a functional liaison and attends and contributes to key meetings between Blue Yonder project team, key customer contacts, and customer users, up to and including key executive project sponsors
* Understands how the Blue Yonder solutions within the area of focus can be configured and delivered to better facilitate customer business processes (ensuring the ability to design, execute, and deliver)
* Setup and coordinate user acceptance testing efforts which will support final acceptance and critical phase sign-off by the business owners
* Follows up on cases opened with Blue Yonder Support Services to help in resolving defects for the customer.
* Provides non-technical end user support during the 'go-live' and post-go-live period
* Ensures knowledge transfer is conducted with key customer project team/end users to maximize the customers on their own success after Blue Yonder’s project roll-off
* Communicate project risks that may have a negative impact on the project schedule, scope or budget
* Escalate project issues which surface and cannot be quickly resolved which will have an impact on the project schedule, scope, or budget
* Completes assigned and agreed to work within the allotted time and with a high level of quality
* Always conducts oneself in a professional manner with Blue Yonder customers and internal associates

**What We Are Looking For**

* 10-12 years of hands on experience, as a functional consultant providing supply chain solutions for customers required. Either a customer of Blue Yonder or as a consultant implementing Blue Yonder solutions for customers preferred.
* Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics or Operations Research preferred. A combination of Bachelor ’s degree and relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of advanced degree
* Relevant solutions consulting and implementation experience with other leading supply chain planning solutions such as Oracle, SAP, or leading ERP may be considered.
* Strong business analysis skills, understanding and usage of statistical algorithms, SCM concepts, awareness of tactical planning on overall supply chain required
* Relevant industry certification from APICS , TOGAF will be a plus
* Current or prior experience working in Management consulting organization or Supply Chain Center or Excellence settings preferred
* Skill set and availability requirements as per the organization's needs
* Knowledge in performance tuning techniques is added advantage.
* Provides guidance to Support Services in responding to base technical issues.
* Understanding and experience with the technical requirements for the product line assigned.
* Understanding of Database structures. Understanding of various technical platforms and infrastructures.
* Understands Blue Yonder product suite to convey relationships and touch points to the customer.
* Works with appropriate parties to ensure issues are resolved.
* Ability to prepare and deliver presentations for user and management. Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills required
* Extensive Travel required.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

19642379.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
19642379.description:
**Job Description**
MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
**Pre-Sales Consultant**
with strong multi-cloud expertise and hands-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.
  
  
This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution-design capabilities to the RFx process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
The Senior Pre-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Client, Sales & RFx Engagement:

+ Lead the analysis of RFI/RFP/Tender documents to understand customer pain points, objectives, technical landscape, and constraints.
+ Summarize bid details: agency background, contract duration, contract value, scope of work, user journeys, and design-critical considerations.
+ Participate in internal stakeholder/client meetings, discovery/business domain understanding workshops, requirement-gathering sessions and existing client portal research..
+ Collaborate with internal sales (including Salesforce PSS) and delivery teams to align solution direction and ensure feasibility.
+ Support creation of Functional & Technical Requirement Traceability Matrices.

* Solution Design & Architecture (Platform-Agnostic):

+ Architect multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premise solutions that meet functional, technical, security, and compliance requirements.
+ Recommend best-fit technology stacks—Salesforce or otherwise—based purely on customer needs and evaluation criteria.
+ Create high-level and detailed technical architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration patterns.
+ Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high-level solution blueprints.
+ Apply modern architectural principles: microservices, API-led integration, event-driven frameworks, serverless, containerization, and cloud-native patterns.

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Operational Excellence Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**

* Energy Industries is establishing an AI Factory as the AI Transformation Engine for the division. The AI Factory enables, accelerates and scales AI transformation across functions by providing governance, expertise, delivery capabilities, reusable assets and capability development.
* As AI Factory Architecture Lead, you will serve as the divisional AI Technical Authority within the AI Factory, leading and orchestrating architecture activities across the AI Factory ecosystem.
* You will be accountable for ensuring that the right architecture is developed, reviewed and approved to deliver scalable, sustainable, secure and future-ready AI capabilities. You will set technical direction, prioritize and coordinate architecture activities across delivery teams, and ensure that the appropriate competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs.
* This is a technical leadership and design authority role. You will lead the architecture capability and enable architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to create coherent, reusable and future-ready solutions.

  

**Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide***\**

While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience are matching this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.

  

This position does **not require relocation**. The successful candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office

  
You will be mainly accountable for:

* Lead and orchestrate AI architecture across the AI Factory portfolio, setting technical direction, priorities and sequencing of architecture work.
* Provide technical and design authority, reviewing and approving AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* Ensure the right architecture competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs, working with delivery teams and AI Factory Operations to address gaps.
* Drive common architecture, standards and reuse, ensuring that reference architectures, reusable patterns and technical guardrails are developed, maintained and adopted.
* Lead the AI architecture community, connecting architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to share knowledge, challenge approaches and shape technical direction.
* Anticipate the rapid evolution of AI, leading assessment of emerging technologies and ensuring the technology roadmap remains relevant and avoids unnecessary technical debt or early obsolescence.
* Lead technical alignment with Functions, IS, Data organizations, delivery teams and external technology partners, including technical evaluation of delivery approaches and vendors.
* Resolve and govern key architecture decisions, balancing innovation, speed, security, sustainability and long-term maintainability, and escalating significant cross-domain decisions through AI Factory governance where required.

*Our team dynamics*

* You will lead and orchestrate the AI architecture capability across Energy Industries, coordinating architects and technical experts embedded across multiple delivery teams and organizations.
* You will be accountable for technical direction, prioritization of architecture work, appropriate architecture competence and capacity, and approval of AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* The role leads primarily through technical authority, functional leadership and influence rather than direct line management. The approved role already positions this function as the principal AI technical authority influencing architects, engineers, delivery teams and external partners.

**Qualifications for the role** 

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* At least 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, solution design or technology leadership.
* Strong technical background with the credibility to lead senior architects and technical specialists.
* Experience leading architecture or technical work across multiple teams and complex initiatives.
* Experience delivering AI, analytics, machine learning or digital platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of the AI technology ecosystem and emerging trends.
* Ability to translate business priorities into technical direction and make sound decisions balancing speed, quality, reuse and sustainability.
* Strong stakeholder leadership and communication skills.

**Preferred background**

* + Experience in industrial digitalization or engineering-led environments.
  + Experience in technical authority, lead engineering, architecture leadership or comparable functional leadership roles.
  + Experience in consulting, scale-up or high-growth technology environments.
  + Experience leading technical communities and working across internal and external delivery organizations.

**Your application will get our interest if you**

* + Are a technical leader and orchestrator with the depth and credibility to challenge experienced architects and make sound technical decisions.
  + Enjoy enabling talented specialists and creating clarity when priorities compete for limited capacity.
  + Bring a builder mentality, technical curiosity and a practical approach to execution.
  + Are comfortable making decisions in a rapidly changing technology landscape.
  + Influence effectively across organizational boundaries and challenge established thinking constructively.
  + Balance innovation with reuse, maintainability and minimizing technical debt.

*\*This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

*The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.*

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ad7f799e.title: Director Cloud Solution Architect
ad7f799e.description:
**Overview**
The Customer Success Unit brings together deep technical expertise and customer success leadership to help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and realize value from their Microsoft investments. Data and AI sit at the center of every organization's transformation, and our customers are looking to Microsoft to help them modernize their data estates, unlock insights, and build secure, responsible, production-grade AI solutions.
  
  
As the Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) Manager – Data & AI, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of Cloud Solution Architects who help customers and partners design, deploy, and scale solutions across Microsoft's Data & AI portfolio — including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL and Cosmos DB, Power BI, Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry), Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and agentic AI solutions. You will guide the team in translating customer business challenges into data and AI architectures, removing technical blockers, driving operational readiness, accelerating consumption and usage growth, and delivering solutions aligned with Microsoft methodologies and proven practices.
  
  
This opportunity will allow you to strengthen your people leadership, deepen your expertise in data platforms and AI, and help scale repeatable Data & AI patterns and best practices across a diverse portfolio of strategic customers.
  
  
Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Business Impact
  
  

* Coaches the team on operating to required operational excellence and proven practice standards across all engagement stages, activities, and tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, consumption tracking, time tracking).
* Leads the team in orchestrating across Microsoft account teams, specialists, partners, and customer teams to deliver on-strategy Data & AI outcomes and increase customer and partner satisfaction.
* Oversees the team in anticipating and managing business and technical risks for data and AI workloads — including data quality, data governance, model performance, cost, and Responsible AI considerations — applying governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize risk.
* Leads the team in delivering solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., value-based deliverables [VBDs], architecture design sessions, technical validation, training), ensuring proven patterns are followed so customers are operationally ready to run data and AI workloads in production.
* Coaches the team on guiding customers toward well-architected (secure, resilient, governed, AI-ready), cost- and performance-optimized data platforms and AI solutions that increase retention and expansion opportunities.
* Drives the team to proactively identify cross-solution opportunities for Data & AI consumption, usage, and Unified expansion (including Enhanced Solutions) — such as data estate modernization, analytics migration to Microsoft Fabric, generative AI and agentic applications, and Copilot extensibility — based on clear business value to the customer.
* Guides the team on articulating the value of Unified and partnering with account teams to build consumption plans aligned with the right Data & AI services. Leads feedback to the Unified Delivery team on Data & AI VBDs to refine and further develop content.
* Leverages change management proven practices (or engages the change management team) to help customers drive long-term organizational adoption of data and AI solutions, including data literacy and AI adoption.
* Drives the team on anticipating, identifying, escalating, and mitigating blockers — such as data readiness, platform limits, capacity and quota, security reviews, and skills gaps — to accelerate deployment, value realization, and consumption.
* Leads the team to capture opportunities in appropriate systems and tools, working collaboratively across the organization in alignment with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.

Customer Centricity
  
  

* Coaches the team to focus on customer and partner experience through efficient delivery and a seamless, connected customer experience; drives realization of customer conditions of success.
* Leads the team in anticipating and resolving customer dissatisfaction through customer confidence calls, and in executing strategies to improve experience, value realization, and speed of transformation.
* Supports the team in translating customer business problems into Data & AI solutions aligned with Microsoft's platform strategy — explaining how they meet business outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals through proofs of concept, minimum viable products (MVPs), and rapid prototypes, relative to competitive offerings.
* Coaches the team on building trusted relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs) up to the C-suite — including Chief Data Officers (CDOs), Chief Data & Analytics Officers, Chief AI Officers, CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs — and bridging understanding between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs).
* Elevates engagements with CXO stakeholders on data governance, data privacy, security, compliance, and Responsible AI requirements, engaging additional subject matter experts where deeper expertise is required.
* Leads the team in acting as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback, insights, success stories, and technical input with Engineering, Product, and internal communities. Coaches the team on identifying patterns across customers to develop actionable insights and on presenting business cases that influence product roadmaps and bug-fix prioritization.

Partner Specialization
  
  

* Actively orchestrates initiatives, leveraging an expansive knowledge of the Data & AI partner ecosystem to select and champion the most qualified partners for complex customer projects.
* Collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) stakeholders and Partner Technology Specialist (PTS) leadership to translate Data & AI opportunities into action, fostering technical and solution coherence across Microsoft partner and sales ecosystems.
* Concentrates on identifying and prioritizing opportunities that align with the organization's strategic revenue and consumption goals, directing partner and sales support through proofs of concept and technical pre-sales guidance.

People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
  
  

* Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.
* Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
* Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual's capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Leads the team in identifying gaps through delivery and connecting patterns across business and technology areas to drive improvements to products, intellectual property (IP), and practices that enable Data & AI solutions to scale across customers.
* Coaches the team on contributing to Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies (e.g., Cloud Adoption Framework for data and AI, Well-Architected Framework, Responsible AI Standard).
* Leads the team in contributing to and building reusable IP — reference architectures, accelerators, and solution patterns — especially where no IP exists yet (e.g., generative AI, AI agents, Copilot extensibility, RAG, and real-time intelligence scenarios).
* Enables the team to lead and assemble virtual teams (v-teams) around Data & AI technologies and customer challenges, sharing insights with technical communities across the field using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and the competitive landscape (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud).
* Drives recognition for Microsoft Data & AI solutions by leading and encouraging the team's participation in internal and external events (e.g., Ignite, Build, Fabric Community Conference, Tech Connect, meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons).
* Uses market insights and demand signals to help leadership prioritize up-skilling and accreditations. Drives the team to role-model technical readiness — depth in Data & AI (data engineering, analytics, data science, MLOps/LLMOps, generative and agentic AI) and breadth across CSU priorities such as security, resilience, and AI.
* Ensures team members dedicate time to continuous learning and certification, monitoring progress and providing guidance where appropriate.

**Qualifications**
Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or related field AND 8+ years of experience in data platforms, analytics, AI/machine learning, cloud technologies, technology consulting, software development, solution architecture, and/or practice development; OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects, consultants, or technical specialist teams.

**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, with hands-on experience designing and delivering data and AI solutions.
* 6+ years of experience leading technical projects, teams, or functions.
* Strong working knowledge of modern data and AI architectures (e.g., lakehouse, data mesh, real-time analytics, MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents) and Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Power BI, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Foundry, and Azure OpenAI.
* Understanding of data governance, security, and Responsible AI principles and tooling (e.g., Microsoft Purview).
* Technical certifications in data and AI (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Fabric Data Engineer Associate, Azure Data Scientist Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent).
* 5+ years of people management experience, including managing technical architects or consulting practice managers.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

0c4fcf64.title: Senior IT Service Delivery Manager
0c4fcf64.description:
**ABOUT WIZARDTALES**

Wizardtales Private Limited works in cloud infrastructure and IT services, bringing together technical expertise and international collaboration to deliver dependable services for our customers.

Our supportive, collaborative culture reflects the German work ethics we value: reliability, punctuality, clear communication, quality and keeping our commitments. We believe ambitious work and a healthy work-life balance belong together.

We offer the opportunity to contribute ideas, develop your skills and grow your responsibilities as the business develops.

**YOUR ROLE**

You will connect our German-speaking customers with our technical team, ensuring that requests are understood, priorities are clear and commitments are met.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys service delivery, takes responsibility and follows through without needing constant reminders.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Communicate confidently with customers in German through calls, meetings, emails and ticket updates.
* Make sure every ticket has an owner, a priority and clear next steps, and follow through until resolution.
* Coordinate engineers and colleagues, clarify responsibilities and help remove blockers.
* Prioritize urgent incidents, customer commitments and planned work according to impact and available capacity.
* Identify delays and risks early, manage escalations and keep customers informed.
* Improve workflows, documentation and communication to make service delivery more reliable.
* Give management concise updates on progress, outstanding issues and decisions requiring attention.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* A minimum of five years of relevant industry experience in IT services, managed services, cloud infrastructure or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing customer-facing service delivery and coordinating technical teams.
* Fluent spoken and written German, supported by a German language certificate.
* Strong English communication skills for working with the wider team.
* Experience with ticketing systems, incident management, service commitments and customer escalations.
* Enough technical understanding to discuss IT issues confidently and coordinate effectively with engineers.
* Strong organization, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.
* The ability to work independently and communicate proactively in a remote environment.

Experience supporting German-speaking customers and familiarity with ITIL practices would be an advantage.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Fully remote work from India.
* A respectful, supportive and collaborative team culture.
* An international working environment with German-speaking customers and colleagues.
* Trust, ownership and the opportunity to influence how we work.
* A commitment to healthy work-life balance, realistic planning and sustainable workloads.
* Opportunities to learn, develop professionally and grow your responsibilities with the business.

Contact: Suneetha.gurtzick@wizardtales.com

80b72583.title: Associate Vice President - Program Manager
80b72583.description:
**Job Description :**

**About the Function:**

Global Business Operations keeps our business moving, connecting markets, streamlining processes and keeping everything running smoothly at scale.

With teams across Bangalore, Budapest, Bogotá, Gurugram, and Manila, GBO delivers the essential services that support our day-to-day performance, from finance to operations and beyond. It’s a truly global environment, where collaboration across time zones and cultures is part of everyday life.

You’ll gain exposure to different markets, build skills for the future and develop a broad understanding of how a business operates at scale. It’s a great place to learn, grow and see the bigger picture.

**About the role:**

1. End-to-End Program & Transition Delivery

* Own delivery against agreed scope, outcomes, schedule, budget and landmarks.
* Translate the reason and strategic objectives into an integrated delivery and transition plan.
* Drive execution from initiation and design through build, deployment, stabilization and closure.
* Maintain overall accountability for delivery health and proactively intervene where outcomes are at risk.
* Orchestrate dependencies across process, technology, data, operations, infrastructure, change, risk and controls.
* Establish clear achievements, critical paths, dependencies, owners and decision points.
* Ensure individual workstreams collectively deliver the intended end-to-end business outcome.
* Proactively identify and manage program and transition risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies.
* Drive mitigation and resolution with clear accountable owners.

2. Transition & Operational Readiness

* Own the integrated readiness framework across people, process, technology, knowledge and controls.
* Drive knowledge transfer, resource onboarding, training and business simulation readiness.
* Coordinate process documentation, technology/infrastructure readiness, testing, access, controls and BCP requirements.
* Ensure readiness criteria are evidenced and critical gaps are resolved ahead of launch.

3. Governance & Leadership

* Establish effective program governance, RACI, Steering Committee and decision forums.
* Drive readiness for toll-gate and governance reviews.
* Ensure decisions, actions and issues happen at the right level and time.
* Provide leadership with clear, concise visibility of delivery health, landmarks, readiness, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
* Maintain adherence to agreed project methodology and governance requirements.

4. Customer & Change Coordination

* Create alignment across business sponsors, functional leaders, operations, technology teams and enabling functions.
* Partner with Change Management to integrate customer engagement, communications, training and adoption into the overall program.
* Drive timely customer decisions required to maintain delivery momentum.

5. Cutover & Go-Live

* Own and coordinate the integrated cutover and launch plan.
* Ensure critical business, technology and operational readiness criteria are achieved.
* Facilitate launch readiness assessments and support Steering Committee decision making.
* Coordinate cross-functional execution during cutover and deployment.
* Ensure effective issue and issue-management mechanisms are in place during release.

6. Stabilization, Warranty & Operational Handover

* Lead delivery through hypercare, stabilization and warranty.
* Monitor operational and process performance against agreed measures.
* Ensure business stabilization criteria are achieved before transition closure.
* Complete structured handover to operations and secure appropriate operational sign-off.

7. Business Outcomes & Benefits

* Keep delivery anchored to the approved reason and intended outcomes.
* Track delivery against agreed business, operational and financial measures.
* Ensure the program delivers measurable outcomes rather than simply completing project activities.
* Support validation of benefits and performance against the reason.
* Drive formal outcome sign-off, lessons learned and program closure

**Experience / skills required:**

* 15+ years of meaningful experience, with significant experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation, transition or technology-enabled programs.
* Tried ownership of end-to-end program delivery across scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, governance and business outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience orchestrating multiple workstreams across business, process, technology, data, people/change and operations.
* Strong experience handling business readiness, knowledge transfer, testing, cutover, go-live, hypercare, stabilization and operational handover.
* Tried ability to operate with senior leadership and Steering Committees, influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage ambiguity and drive decisions and accountability

PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner or equivalent program/project management certification

Agile/Scrum certification such as PSM, CSM, SAFe

Prosci / Change Management certification beneficial for roles with significant people/change complexity.

**Working with us**  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, give and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to improve, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to give an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

Regular

1018f3a3.title: Engagement Manager
1018f3a3.description:
**About Us**

Straive is a global leader in data analytics and AI operationalization, helping enterprises embed advanced AI and data capabilities into core business workflows to deliver measurable business outcomes and ROI. With a workforce of ~20,000 professionals serving 350+ clients across 30+ markets, Straive combines technical scale with deep domain expertise. A key differentiator is its network of over 6,000 subject matter experts who specialize in managing and enriching complex, unstructured data enabling organizations to build AI systems grounded in accuracy, context, and business relevance.

  

**About the Role**

Straive is seeking a strategic and driven Engagement Manager / Senior Engagement Manager to lead and coordinate data analytics and AI engagements for strategic enterprise clients across global markets. As a trusted AI consulting partner, this is a high-impact, client-facing role with significant exposure to senior client stakeholders and Straive leadership.

You will be responsible for translating complex business challenges into scalable AI/analytics

solutions, acting as the primary bridge between business leaders and technical delivery teams.

The role requires fluency in AI concepts (ML, GenAI, LLMs) and a track record of owning end-to-end delivery. You will oversee project execution, drive account growth, manage P&L, and shape strategic programs in an AI-first organization.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Engagement Planning & End-to-End Delivery

• Define engagement charters, delivery plans, and milestones across concurrent AI and data

workstreams.

• Oversee successful execution of analytics and AI initiatives from inception to completion.

  

2. Client & Stakeholder Management

• Engage with CXO / VP-level stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and success metrics.

• Build trusted-advisor relationships, managing expectations and delivering exceptional client experiences.

  

3. Strategic Translation & Solutioning

• Translate unstructured client questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and

analytical workplans.

• Develop AI roadmaps aligning with client vision and business objectives.

  

4. Account Growth & Business Development

• Proactively identify new opportunity areas where AI and analytics can deliver incremental

value.

• Drive proposal creation, RFP responses, SOWs, and executive presentations clearly

articulating business value.

  

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

• 10+ years of total professional experience across strategy consulting, analytics consulting, or technology-enabled transformation roles.

• Minimum of 7+ years of relevant experience managing and delivering data analytics, data

science, and AI-driven projects.

• Proven track record of leading end-to-end AI/ML solution delivery across global enterprise

clients.

• Strong fluency in AI terminology and concepts (e.g., classical AI/ML, GenAI, LLMs).

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience interfacing with C-suite and VP-level executives.

• Experience managing account-level P&L and contributing to RFPs and business development efforts.

49eec587.title: Technical Program Manager
49eec587.description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Technical Program Manager

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.

Responsibilities:

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives
* Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership
* Build roadmaps that balance near-term deliverables with the longer-term technical direction of each program
* Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets
* Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines
* Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations
* Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post-launch reviews
* Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling
* Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role
* A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs
* Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus
* Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations
* Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong relationship-building skills: you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan
* A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

affa3dcd.title: ISP Program Manager
affa3dcd.description:
**Role Overview**
The Program Manager – OSAT is responsible for leading large, complex customer programs from concept through high-volume manufacturing. This role serves as the single point of accountability for program execution—integrating customer requirements, engineering development, supply chain, and factory operations to ensure on-time, on-cost, and on-quality delivery.
  
  
A major focus of this position is operations readiness for new products (NPI to HVM transition), including capacity planning, qualification, ramp management, and alignment of cross-functional teams within an outsourced semiconductor assembly and test environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership & Execution**

* Own end-to-end execution of multiple customer programs within the OSAT business unit.
* Act as the primary interface between customers and internal organizations (Technology Development, Factory NPI and Process Engineering, Operations/Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance).
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive structured program governance: stage gates, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
* Manage program financials including cost optimisation models, margins, and change management.

**Customer Engagement**

* Lead customer technical and business reviews, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and performance.
* Translate customer requirements into actionable internal plans.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure rapid issue resolution.
* Support commercial teams in RFQs, SOWs, and new business opportunities.

**Operations Readiness & NPI**

* Lead NPI to HVM transition activities including:

+ Factory readiness (equipment, capacity, tooling, materials)
+ Qualification planning (DOE, reliability, process validation)
+ Yield ramp strategies and learning cycles

* Coordinate process development, product engineering, and manufacturing teams.
* Ensure BOM, process flows, test programs, and quality controls are production-ready.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Chair core team meetings and drive accountability across functions.
* Manage risk registers, mitigation plans, and contingency strategies.
* Partner with Industrial Engineering on line design, cycle time, and capacity modeling.
* Align with Quality on customer qualifications, audits, and compliance.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Establish program management best practices, KPIs, and dashboards.
* Drive lessons-learned and standardization across programs.
* Support digitalization of program tracking and factory execution.

**Required Qualifications**- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Materials, Industrial) or related field.
- 15+ years of experience in semiconductor manufacturing, OSAT, or advanced packaging.
- Relevant years of experience in program/project management with direct customer ownership.
- Proven experience with:
- New Product Introduction (NPI) and HVM ramp
- Assembly & Test processes (wire bond, flip chip, WLCSP, BGA, SiP, etc.)
- Semiconductor quality systems (APQP, FMEA, Control Plans, 8D)
- Strong knowledge of:

* Manufacturing operations, capacity planning, and yield management
* Supply chain coordination and material readiness
* Cost modeling and program financial management
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**- Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, or MBA.
- Experience working directly in an OSAT or IDM ATM environment.
- PMP / PgMP / PRINCE2 certification.
- Hands-on background in:

* Package development and reliability qualification
* Test engineering and product bring-up
* Factory automation and MES systems
* Experience with Tier-1 global customers in mobile, automotive, HPC, or networking.
* Six Sigma Green/Black Belt certification.

46933d4d.title: Technical Program Manager (Ad Serving)
46933d4d.description:

ShowHeroes is a global leader in CTV and digital video advertising solutions. Through premium publisher partnerships, advanced contextual targeting technology, and innovative creative formats, the company helps brands and publishers build meaningful audience connections across all screens.

Powered by its SemanticHero AI platform, ShowHeroes delivers highly relevant, privacy-conscious advertising, and video solutions at scale. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, the company operates internationally across Europe, Latin America, and Asia.

The Demand team is responsible for our ad serving and ad creatives services that are used across thousands of publisher websites. This technology enables omni-channel ad serving of video and display advertisements, using contextual targeting, on all device types. The focus is on providing reach, context and high-impact ad formats whilst optimizing monetization for publishers. The team is expanding capabilities into new areas including agentic buying and multi-screen targeting.

As a Technical Program Manager at ShowHeroes Group, you’ll lead multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. In this role, you'll leverage your business and technical expertise in ad technology while maintaining a strong focus on user-facing aspects, ensuring both short-term impact and long-term strategic growth.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on a mature, established product used at scale, with room for significant impact on future design and features.

The successful candidate will decide whether to work entirely remotely, from one of our 26 office locations, or any hybrid approach.

* Drive technical discussions with the engineering team leads and create functional specifications, doing independent research where necessary.
* Together with the product manager and engineering team leads, you will define project scopes, timelines, and deliverables.
* Prioritize development effort based on business value, technical complexity, and strategic goals.
* Coordinate cross-functional efforts between other product teams, engineering and external stakeholders.
* Manage project schedules and manage project/feature releases.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years experience in program/product management in advertising technology, software engineering, or related field.
* Hands-on experience with digital advertising, for example: SSPs, DSPs, ad servers, ad operations or creative ad formats.
* Working knowledge of digital advertising standards such as Prebid, oRTB, VAST, VPAID, ad podding, SSAI, IAB taxonomy and similar technologies.
* Understanding of web technologies including HTML5, JavaScript, and browser capabilities.
* Demonstrable experience with Agile software development methodologies and productivity tools.
* Proficient in English.

**What's In It for You**

* A technology and media company with numerous branches worldwide (e.g. Paris, New York, São Paulo, Milan and Berlin)
* Flexible workplace and working hours
* A friendly and inclusive culture with equal opportunities for everyone
* A place to grow and take initiative
* One mental health day per year to focus on your well-being
* Team events, winter parties, and more to celebrate our successes together
* Four impact days per year to contribute positively to our environment and society

*People at ShowHeroes*

*At ShowHeroes, we are committed to fair and objective decision-making across all stages of the employee lifecycle. This includes recruitment, hiring, promotion, and compensation processes.*

*We evaluate candidates and employees based on qualifications, performance, and alignment with our company values, regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, or disability.*

4871f8bb.title: Program Manager – R&D
4871f8bb.description:
**Overview**
The Program Manager leads hardware and software development projects. They are responsible for enforcing best practices within the teams, ensuring delivery of customer-centric products while enforcing adherence to company policies and procedures, and compliance requirements, while mentoring and growing the skill set of the team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Provide leadership and umbrella guidance to an interdependent family of programs and projects.
  
  

* Work with product management, sales, marketing, and clinical teams to understand the needs of our customers.
* Manage product requirements, functional specifications, schedules, and risk analyses for programs and projects.
* Work with product management and the Change Review Board to prioritize features and technical improvements and build these into the planned product.
* Program Planning - Collaborates with stakeholders (engineering and test teams, product managers, and senior leadership, etc.) to define the scope, objectives, and deliverables of the projects/program. Develop detailed project plans (MS Project and Microsoft Azure DevOps), taking into account resource availability, timelines, and budget constraints.
* Manage and continually improve the process for planning, execution, and refinements for Program Increments, Sprints, and the overall project schedule.
* Manage the development of required plans and documentation for all development activities.
* Lead 3rd party vendors for manufacturing of medical devices.
* Lead teams to deliver on the plan, with a constant focus on delivering high-quality products that meet customer expectations; follow the Spacelabs QMS; and are fully compliant with government regulations across our customer base, including FDA, CSA, EU, CFDA, and others.
* Build, drive, and support teams through the development process. Set expectations and lead project delivery skill-building among team members.
* Eliminate barriers, escalate issues as appropriate, and provide visibility into development status for other stakeholders. Provide frequent communications and formal project reviews with program team, and others as required.
* Negotiate schedule, risk, product features, and resource trade-offs with project and program teams.
* Uphold the Company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the Company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* Ensure that direct report(s) are trained and evaluated on their knowledge and adherence to the company’s values, Code of Ethics and Conduct, and applicable compliance policies.
* It is the responsibility of every Spacelabs Healthcare employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid the recurrence of the problem.
* Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar related degree. Master’s degree is desirable.
* 5+ years’ experience in software-driven medical device development compliant with IEC 62304
* 5+ years’ experience in hardware-driven medical device development, including design transfer to manufacturing.
* 5+ years’ experience in program management
* 5+ years’ experience in managing complex interdependent new product development projects within demanding timeframes required. Solid understanding of the development process, including requirements gathering, analysis and design, development tools and technologies, release and version control, contemporary testing methodologies, and deployment management.
* Knowledge of FDA and medical device regulatory and registration requirements or work in a similarly regulated industry is desirable.
* Demonstrated track record of encouraging innovation and out-of-the-box thinking.
* Proven ability to deliver results through others, both in direct and matrixed organizational models.
* Proven ability to lead dedicated, passionate teams, including an ability to motivate and hold others accountable – including international teams
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, for both internal and external audiences, at all levels.
* Experience in specifying and shipping software for use in cloud environments is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of and ability to work within a global corporate environment is required.
* Must travel internationally and be able to acquire all necessary travel documents. Travel up to 10%.
* PMI – PMP or PMI-ACP Certification.

**Physical Requirements**- Standing: 0%-5%
- Bending: 0%-5%
- Sitting: 70%-75%
- Stooping: 0%-5%
- Reaching: 0%-5%
