c2b82173.title: Training & Engagement Manager
c2b82173.description:
Key responsibilities

The role covers eight areas, from planning and onboarding to measurement and compliance.

1. Training needs and planning

* Conduct an annual Training Needs Analysis (TNA) with HODs, the Nursing Superintendent, Quality and department heads.
* Prepare and own the Annual Training Calendar covering clinical, technical, behavioural, compliance and leadership training.
* Set training budgets, track utilisation and report ROI.

2. Onboarding and induction

* Run the corporate and departmental induction for all new joiners (doctors, nurses, allied health, admin and support staff).
* Coordinate the buddy/mentor programme and 30-60-90 day check-ins.
* Ensure orientation covers hospital policies, patient rights, code of conduct, fire safety, infection control and BMW management.

3. Clinical and mandatory training

* Coordinate with Nursing, Quality and Medical Education to deliver BLS/ACLS, infection control, hand hygiene, patient safety, medication safety, fire and disaster drills, biomedical waste handling, POSH and NABH-related training.
* Maintain training records, attendance, assessments and certification validity (BLS/ACLS renewals, licences).
* Ensure training evidence is audit-ready for NABH, NABL and statutory inspections.

4. Soft-skills and leadership development

* Run programmes on patient communication, service excellence, empathy, conflict handling, teamwork and customer care.
* Design supervisor and first-time manager programmes and succession-readiness initiatives.
* Manage external trainers, institutes and e-learning/LMS vendors.

5. Employee engagement

* Plan and execute engagement calendar events: Doctors' Day, Nurses' Day, Hospital Day, festivals, sports, townhalls and family events.
* Design recognition programmes (Employee of the Month, Star Performer, long-service awards, spot awards).
* Run engagement and pulse surveys, exit-interview analysis and stay interviews; develop action plans from findings.
* Run grievance and feedback channels such as suggestion boxes, skip-level meetings and open-house sessions.
* Support employee wellness, including health camps, counselling access and work-life balance initiatives.

6. Measurement and reporting

* Track KPIs: training hours per employee, training coverage %, compliance %, post-training assessment scores, eNPS, attrition and retention, participation in engagement events.
* Prepare monthly MIS and quarterly dashboards for HR and management.
* Evaluate training effectiveness using Kirkpatrick levels (reaction, learning, behaviour, results).

7. Culture and employer branding

* Reinforce hospital values and culture through communication, campaigns and storytelling.
* Support talent acquisition with employer-branding initiatives.

8. Compliance and coordination

* Maintain training SOPs, policies, templates and the training database or LMS.
* Coordinate with Quality, Nursing, Medical Administration, Infection Control and Facility teams.
* Manage training and engagement vendors, contracts and invoices within budget.

Qualifications and experience

The role needs an HR or hospital administration postgraduate with 5-8 years in training and engagement, at least 3 of them in healthcare.

* **Education:** MBA / PGDM in HR, or Master's in Social Work (HR) / Hospital Administration. A Bachelor's with strong relevant experience may be considered.
* **Certifications (preferred):** Training & Development, L&D or OD. Train-the-Trainer certification is an advantage.
* **Experience:** 5-8 years in Training / L&D / Employee Engagement, with at least 3 years in a hospital or healthcare setting.
* **Exposure (preferred):** NABH-accredited hospitals and clinical training coordination.

Skills and competencies

The role combines facilitation and data skills with stakeholder management across doctors, nurses and senior leadership.

* Strong facilitation, presentation and communication skills (English and Hindi)
* Training design, instructional methods and assessment
* Knowledge of NABH training and documentation requirements
* Familiarity with LMS and HRMS tools; advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Data analysis and survey design
* Stakeholder management with doctors, nurses and senior leadership
* Event planning and vendor management
* Empathy, creativity and a strong service orientation

Key performance indicators

Performance is judged on training coverage and compliance, engagement participation and retention, against these indicative targets.

Working conditions

The role is mainly day shift, with flexibility for early or late sessions so night staff are covered, and regular movement across wards and departments.

95e9dc6f.title: Senior Customer Experience Program Manager
95e9dc6f.description:
**Overview**
Capacity Operations Team within Azure Fleet Platform is responsible for connecting customer demand with infrastructure supply across Microsoft's global cloud footprint. The team enables reliable, scalable, and predictable cloud capacity for Azure and other Microsoft cloud services by driving capacity planning, allocation, risk management, and optimization.
  
  
Working closely with customers, engineering, and infrastructure teams, the Capacity Team develops the frameworks, processes, and systems required to deliver an exceptional capacity experience. The team focuses on forecasting demand, mitigating capacity risks, improving utilization, and ensuring customers can successfully deploy and scale their workloads in the Microsoft Cloud. Through data-driven insights, automation, and operational excellence, the Capacity Team helps ensure Microsoft's cloud capacity is available where and when customers need it most.
  
  
We are looking for a passionate and knowledgeable Senior Program Manager to join the Capacity Operations team. The Capacity Operations team is responsible for delivering the best capacity customer experience by ensuring an optimal and reliable platform, world-class customer support, and scalable and compliant operations process. This role collaborates with multiple stakeholders, including engineering, customer owners, service owners, 24x7 support vendors to drive innovation for operational support.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Track overall support effectiveness and health, analyzing customer satisfaction and quality data.
* Address support process, data and system gaps impacting the customer.
* Monitor key operation metrics and drive operation process improvements.
* Provide visibility to process and system issues, collaborating with engineering/product/business teams to drive improvements, automation, and efficiency.
* Provide visibility to platform capacity reliability issues and collaborate with platform teams to eliminate customer failures as it relates to capacity.
* Technical advisor/escalation for issues outside of the vendor operations knowledge and capability.
* Collaborate across a diverse set of business stakeholders, including the Azure engineering team, to design new deployment and platform capabilities.
* Facilitate industry-standard Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for premium customers

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND (5-8 years)experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

+ Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
+ OR equivalent experience.

* 7+ years of technical and business experience in the following or related areas: engineering, program management, capacity management, capacity optimization, program management, cloud capacity management.
* Azure Platform or Operations within a cloud service architecture, deployment and configuration.
* Deep understanding of cloud services, usage scenarios and implementations. Experience working in or with cloud engineering teams preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, synthesize complex issues/scenarios into easy-to-understand concepts and drive quick customer resolution and influence the long-term success plan.

a9147f73.title: Program Manager I, Flex Advocacy Operations
a9147f73.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Flex program uses independent drivers—called delivery partners—to deliver to our customers. Through the Amazon Flex app, drivers sign up for the program, schedule pickup times, are guided during routes with the navigation system, and more.
  
  
As the Amazon Flex Program Manager, you will be responsible for the strategy and initiatives aimed at improving the quality and efficiency of the deliveries carried out by the program. To achieve your goals, you'll work with diverse areas of the organization, including technology, operations, and marketing. A successful program manager will work to enhance the experience of hundreds of drivers, both within operations and when carrying out delivery routes, through data analysis, identifying obstacles and problem spots, and implementing effective and well-defined standards. These improvements must be balanced with business needs and take into account key operational metrics. Effective stakeholder management skills are essential to balance these competing priorities and delivering effective solutions for our customers and drivers.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Support long-term strategic planning to improve quality and efficiency.
  
  

* Work closely with the areas of finance, marketing, capacity management, operations, engineering, and program management on process improvement and launch initiatives.
* Develop, implement, and oversee reports, ensuring clear visibility of project milestones and performance.
* Effectively influence stakeholders through collaboration and effective prioritization.
* Be responsible for key performance indicators and work closely with stakeholders to understand everyday opportunities and challenges in order to implement short and long-term solutions.
* Monitor the execution of projects and ensure that the delivery is at the appropriate quality level and in compliance with the expected deadline.
* Navigate and resolve ambiguities by applying creative problem solving skills.
* Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from becoming larger problems.

**About The Team**
Amazon Flex's Advocacy Operations (AO) team is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Amazon Flex programs and initiatives worldwide. As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for defining and executing the program roadmap for the Advocacy Operations, translating strategic goals into structured programs, aligning stakeholders, and driving initiatives to completion across a complex, multi-marketplace landscape.
  
  
You will own programs end to end, shaping the charter and success metrics, building mechanisms and roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and reporting progress to senior leadership. Throughout this process you will drive continuous innovation and improvement to deliver fast, easy, and rich functionality that supports a best-in-class Delivery Partner (DP) and customer experience. A critical part of this role is working across teams and marketplaces. You will partner with Operations, Analytics, Tech/Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders, and coordinate with regional teams across worldwide Flex-enabled marketplaces (US, CA, UK, IN, JP, AU, SG, MX, BR), to align priorities, drive consistent execution, and land programs that scale globally while respecting local nuances. You will lead through influence rather than direct authority aligned on shared goals across DP lifecycle, bulk communications, compliance workflows, and programmatic support.
  
  
You will play a pivotal role in defining and delivering strategic automation initiatives, identifying opportunities to build long-term, scalable solutions that eliminate manual work without negatively impacting the DP experience. You will establish the mechanisms, standards, and reporting cadences that keep programs on track and give leadership clear visibility into progress, risks, and outcomes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of SQL

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

e38fb1c5.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI and Customer Solutions
e38fb1c5.description:
**About Coursera + Udemy**
Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.
  
  
**Why join us now?**
AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.
  
  
**Shape What Comes Next**
By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will join a fast-paced innovation team that builds and deploys AI-powered solutions directly with Coursera's enterprise and campus customers. You will sit at the intersection of AI/Data Engineering, cloud and security architecture, and customer-facing solutioning — working hands-on with customers to map their workflows and data, prototype solutions quickly, and harden the ones that prove valuable into production deployments.
  
  
You'll operate across the full engagement lifecycle: scoping a customer's environment and pain points like a consultant, prototyping working demos in real time with the customer, and then hardening the strongest patterns into production-grade, secure and compliant deployments. This role is customer-facing and will require regular travel to customer sites (domestic and occasionally international) for discovery, prototyping, and go-live phases of engagements. You will work closely with Product Managers, AI Specialists, Data Analysts, and other Engineers on the team, and directly with customer executive sponsors and IT/data owners, to decide what gets standardized, deployed, or retired.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Scope customer environments directly with executive sponsors and IT/data owners — mapping systems, data models, and workflows to identify the real business problem, not just the stated one
* Rapidly prototype and demo working solutions in front of customers, iterating in real time to prove value fast
* Serve as the bridge between customer & core engineering team to harden validated prototypes into production deployments
* Design and implement multi-tenant, hybrid, or customer-controlled deployment architectures, as per customer's data residency, privacy, and IT-maturity requirements
* Build and own identity and access management, encryption, and secure cross-network connectivity (mTLS, VPC peering/PrivateLink, API gateways) for customer-embedded deployments
* Bring security, data-residency and compliance judgment into discovery conversations before a commercial commitment is made, not after
* Own CI/CD, observability, and production support for systems living inside customer environments
* Recognize repeatable patterns across customer engagements and feed field evidence back to Product to inform what should be standardized, deployed more broadly, or retired
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, AI Specialists, and Program Managers to scope problem statements with a laser focus on customer and business impact
* Travel to customer sites as needed (expect regular travel) to support scoping, prototyping, and go-live phases of an engagement, including in-person workshops and executive readouts

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with strong hands-on backend engineering and cloud infrastructure experience
* 1+ years of experience building production-grade agentic AI solutions
* Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, Java, Typescript and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Kafka with comfort working across the stack
* Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred), able to design and operate both multi-tenant and hybrid customer-cloud deployment models
* Strong experience with data engineering fundamentals — ingesting, cleaning, and normalizing messy, inconsistent customer data across disparate source systems
* Working knowledge of identity and access management, encryption/key management, and secure network patterns (VPC peering, PrivateLink, mTLS) for customer-embedded or regulated environments
* Demonstrated comfort operating directly with customers — scoping ambiguous problems, running discovery, and demoing work-in-progress solutions live, in person and remotely
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to customer sites, domestically and occasionally internationally, as engagement needs require
* Prior experience leading projects and debugging complex issues with minimal supervision

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with modern agentic AI tooling such as LangChain, LangGraph, FastMCP, RAG, or MCP
* Experience with Postgres, DuckDB, pgvector, or similar analytical/transactional data layers
* Prior experience in a solutions engineering, professional services, or technical consulting role where you owned a customer relationship end-to-end, including on-site engagement
* Familiarity with data privacy and residency regimes relevant to enterprise/education/government customers (e.g., GDPR, FERPA, DPDPA, HIPAA)
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and make sound technical trade-offs with limited guidance
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical constraints into terms an executive sponsor or non-technical stakeholder can act on

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on high-visibility engineering problems with direct, measurable impact on enterprise and campus customers
* Work directly with strategic customers across geographies, owning engagements end-to-end rather than a narrow slice of a roadmap
* Directly influence what graduates from customer-facing custom solutions into Coursera's core product
* Be part of a lean, cross-functional team (Engineering, AI Specialists, Product, Program Management) with high autonomy and high trust and become a go-to technical leader
* Be part of a mission-driven company transforming global access to education and upskilling in the AI era

For more information about how Coursera collects and uses your personal information, please see our Coursera + Udemy Global Applicant Privacy Notice.
  
  
To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page.
  
  
If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.
  
  
Coursera is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and provide reasonable accommodations upon request at recruiting@coursera.org.

**Embedded Software Architect**

At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. **What’s in it for you:**

Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as an **Embedded Software Architect**. In this pivotal role, you will facilitate the design and manufacturing of our current & next line of exciting products. As an Architect, you will collaborate closely with the firmware team & cross-functional teams to build industry-relevant products that meet required specifications for our global customers. * Develop multithreaded applications and libraries for embedded systems, ensuring efficiency and scalability.
* Oversee firmware performance optimization, memory management, bootloader strategy, and power‑management architectures.
* Identify and suggest improvements for products and its quality.
* Work on new product development, new technology initiatives & productivity improvements.
* Establish coding standards, architectural guidelines, and best practices for embedded Linux development.
* Conduct design reviews, risk assessments, and feasibility studies.
* Support security architecture including secure boot, OTA firmware updates, and data protection.
* Serve as a technical mentor to firmware engineering teams.

**What you will bring:**

* Experience in design and development of an Embedded Systems.
* Expert knowledge in developing modular application software using C for an Embedded Linux system.
* Experience in writing multithreaded application software’s and libraries for Embedded Linux system.
* Strong expertise in embedded Linux, including kernel configuration, device drivers, BSP creation, and system services.
* Experience with ARM-based microprocessors and SoCs.
* Good knowledge of Hardware/Software interfaces and reading schematics.
* Experience in communication interfaces like CAN, RS232, I2C, SPI, Bluetooth/BLE & GSM AT Commands.
* Experience in standard automotive communication protocols like J1939.
* Experience in using various tools like static code analysis, run time debugging tools like GDB & memory debugging tools like Valgrind.
* Experience in managing cross functional stakeholders.
* Experience in release planning and executions.
* An innovative approach to improve processes and solve problems.
* Good working knowledge in agile-based product development methodology.
* Effective communication, interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in Telematics domain is an added advantage.
* A degree in engineering with 15+ years of experience in embedded software development with at least 5 years in an architect role.

**Career Break:**

  

We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. 195e9f1b.title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect-SENIOR MANAGER
195e9f1b.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: SAP Delivery Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 10+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end-to-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end-to-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit-to-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.

**Delivery Governance & Program Leadership**

* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.

**Integration, Data & Technical Oversight**

* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event-driven patterns, middleware, and third-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.

**Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit-to-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post-go-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP & Transformation Expertise**

* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.

**Technical Architecture Skills**

* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.

**Leadership & Consulting Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk management skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 10+ years of experience in respective domain.
* Solution Architecture
* Lead end-to-end solutioning activities for SAP transformation opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, and proposal responses.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, account teams, and subject matter experts to define winning SAP solution strategies aligned with client requirements
* Lead end-to-end SAP solution architecture across core SAP S/4HANA business processes and cross-workstream integration points.
* Translate business requirements and process designs into scalable SAP architecture, including fit-to-standard, extension, integration, reporting, security, and data considerations.
* Provide architecture oversight for SAP modules such as Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Plant Maintenance, Quality, Warehouse, Transportation, and HR interfaces, as applicable to the program scope.
* Define and govern solution principles, architectural guardrails, design decisions, and key integration patterns across SAP and non-SAP systems.
* Review functional and technical solution documents to ensure design completeness, consistency, and alignment with SAP best practices.

**Delivery Governance & Program Leadership**

* Support full lifecycle SAP program delivery from discovery, design and build through testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Drive architecture governance forums, solution review boards, design workshops, risk reviews, and key decision-making discussions.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leads, technical leads, and client stakeholders to manage scope, dependencies, delivery plans, risks, issues, and quality gates.
* Identify cross-functional gaps early and coordinate resolution across business process, application, integration, data, security, infrastructure, and change teams.
* Prepare leadership-ready architecture updates, decision papers, options analysis, and steering committee inputs.

**Integration, Data & Technical Oversight**

* Provide oversight for SAP integration architecture using SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, RFCs, event-driven patterns, middleware, and third-party platforms.
* Collaborate with data migration teams on data strategy, conversion design, mock migration planning, reconciliation, validation, cutover sequencing, and defect resolution.
* Assess custom developments, enhancements, RICEFW objects, forms, workflows, reports, and extensions to ensure maintainability and clean-core alignment.
* Guide technical teams on architecture fitment across SAP S/4HANA, SAP RISE, BTP services, cloud integrations, analytics, identity, authorization, and infrastructure dependencies.

**Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure adherence to SAP Activate, fit-to-standard principles, agile delivery practices, documentation standards, and program quality gates.
* Conduct solution walkthroughs, design validations, test readiness reviews, cutover readiness checkpoints, and post-go-live stabilization reviews.
* Promote reusable assets, templates, accelerators, architectural playbooks, and delivery improvements across the SAP Architecture Team.
* Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation planning across architecture, integration, data migration, performance, security, and operational readiness.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Core SAP & Transformation Expertise**

* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture, SAP Activate methodology, enterprise process integration, and large transformation delivery models.
* Broad knowledge of SAP functional domains and cross-module integration across finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, maintenance, quality, sales, and related business areas.
* Ability to evaluate business requirements, solution options, SAP standard capabilities, custom extension needs, integration requirements, and downstream operational implications.
* Experience with ECC to SAP S/4HANA transformation, brownfield, greenfield, selective data transition, or hybrid delivery approaches.

**Technical Architecture Skills**

* Working knowledge of SAP BTP, CPI, PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, CDS views, Fiori, roles and authorizations, analytics, workflow, and cloud integration principles.
* Understanding of SAP RISE, hyperscaler environments, network/security dependencies, transport strategy, landscape planning, and operational readiness.
* Experience reviewing RICEFW scope, custom code remediation, simplification items, integration inventory, interface rationalization, and technical debt reduction.
* Knowledge of data migration strategy, master data governance, reconciliation, validation, migration cockpit, ETL tools, and cutover execution.

**Leadership & Consulting Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management with the ability to engage business leaders, IT leadership, global process owners, vendors, and delivery teams.
* Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts into clear, actionable messages for leadership and project teams.
* Proven ability to lead distributed teams, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, and drive decisions in complex transformation environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk management skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

**Job Description**
The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
  
  
**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
  
  
**Global Family**
We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
  
  
**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Platform Architect to help establish and scale our Data & AI Practice. The role combines modern cloud data architecture, technical solutioning, client advisory, and engineering leadership to deliver enterprise data modernization and AI-ready platforms.  
**Key Responsibilities**

2e21fd23.title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
2e21fd23.description:
**Job Description**
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.
  
  
To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.
  
  
This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.
  
  
Learn more about here!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you’ll do at MongoDB
  
  

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
* Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have
  
  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn
  
  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

8a620075.title: Sr.Architect-Network
8a620075.description:
**Responsibilities**
Architect enterprise network strategies and frameworks spanning cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, with Fortinet as the core platform
  
  
Design and lead Fortinet Secure SD-WAN deployments (FortiGate, FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer), including overlay and underlay topology, SLA-based steering, and failover strategy
  
  
Design and own client and third-party connectivity: site-to-site and partner IPsec VPN, ADVPN, SSL-VPN, and remote access
  
  
Architect NAT strategy for client connectivity, including source and destination NAT, VIPs, IP pools, NAT-T, and overlapping address space resolution
  
  
Evaluate and recommend network technologies, tools, and frameworks, and integrate third-party solutions including firewalls, load balancers, routers, and legacy Palo Alto and Cisco platforms
  
  
Partner with business stakeholders, project managers, and IT teams to align network designs with organizational and client goals
  
  
Ensure designs meet security best practices, regulatory standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2), and organizational policy
  
  
Produce and maintain documentation, cutover runbooks, and rollback plans for review by client architecture teams
  
  
Serve as senior technical escalation point and mentor to engineers
  
  
Drive innovation by proposing and piloting emerging network technologies
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  
  
**Certifications**
Required: Fortinet NSE 4 minimum
  
  
Strongly preferred: NSE 7 (Enterprise Firewall or SD-WAN) or higher
  
  
Preferred: AWS, Azure, or other cloud networking certification
  
  
**Experience**
15+ years of hands-on network engineering and architecture experience in enterprise or managed services environments
  
  
Significant production experience with Fortinet in complex, multi-site environments
  
  
**Knowledge & Skills**
Deep, hands-on Fortinet expertise: FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and Fortinet SD-WAN
  
  
Expert-level IPsec VPN design and troubleshooting (IKEv2, DPD, NAT-T, route-based and policy-based tunnels, ADVPN)
  
  
Expert-level NAT design and troubleshooting across client, partner, and overlapping-subnet scenarios
  
  
Deep expertise in routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS), including BGP as the SD-WAN underlay and overlay routing protocol
  
  
Strong understanding of firewall policy design, load balancers, QoS, and traffic shaping
  
  
Experience with cloud networking (AWS/Azure VPN gateways, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute)
  
  
Proficiency with network design and diagramming tools (Visio, Lucid, or similar)
  
  
Experience with scripting and automation (Python, Ansible, FortiManager API, or similar)
  
  
Experience leading production cutovers with minimal disruption in regulated environments
  
  
Familiarity with Fortinet ZTNA (access proxy, FortiClient EMS) and zero trust concepts is a plus
  
  
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to present to both technical and executive audiences

* Design Agentic AI solutions for IT Operations using Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine to enable reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool invocation, multi-step investigation, recommendation, and operational decision-making
* Architect autonomous and semi-autonomous remediation solutions with policy controls, identity and access checks, risk assessment, Human-in-the-Loop approvals, rollback, recovery validation, auditability, and feedback mechanisms
* Integrate AIOps platforms with ITSM/CMDB, observability, CI/CD, cloud-management, knowledge, security, automation platforms, and enterprise APIs, including ServiceNow or equivalent solutions

* Lead RFP/RFI/RFQ and pre-sales solutioning, including technical discovery, solution architecture, transformation approach, estimations, staffing models, implementation roadmaps, assumptions, risks, dependencies, TCO considerations, and technical proposal development
* Engage with senior customer and executive stakeholders, conduct architecture workshops and solution defenses, and collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Practice, and Commercial teams to develop technically viable and competitive solutions

**Requirements**

* 18-25 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in Enterprise/Solution Architecture, Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, IT Operations, Automation, or AIOps
* Extensive experience architecting large-scale AIOps and intelligent operations platforms, including observability, anomaly detection, event correlation, noise reduction, service-impact analysis, AI-assisted RCA, remediation, and operational automation
* Expertise in at least one major cloud platform – AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, including enterprise cloud architecture, security, identity, networking, governance, resilience, and scalability
* Hands-on architecture experience with at least one Agentic AI ecosystem such as Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine/Google ADK
* Understanding of Agentic AI architectures including reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, RAG/knowledge grounding, context and memory, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation, Human-in-the-Loop, guardrails, and policy enforcement
* Experience designing autonomous/self-healing operations, event-driven remediation, workflow orchestration, ITSM integration, operational governance, and secure interaction between AI agents and enterprise systems
* Proficiency in Python for Agentic AI solutions, APIs, integrations, automation, telemetry processing, orchestration, and rapid prototyping
* Experience in RFP/RFI solutioning, pre-sales architecture, technical proposals, estimations, solution defense, executive stakeholder management, and technical leadership across large enterprise transformation programs

**Nice to have**

* Experience across more than one major cloud platform and familiarity with enterprise observability platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic
* Familiarity with LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Google ADK, MCP, A2A, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs
* Exposure to SRE, FinOps, cloud economics, capacity optimization, predictive operations, and managed-services solutioning
* Relevant Cloud Architect, AI, Enterprise Architecture, SRE, ITIL, or TOGAF certifications

**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
Equivalent education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current infrastructure and solutions to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and high-performing. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced business outcomes.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of cloud migration strategies to ensure seamless transition.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to optimize migration efforts.
* Monitor migration progress and proactively identify risks or issues, proposing effective mitigation plans.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* Experience with cloud platforms and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
* Strong knowledge of cloud architecture principles and best practices for migration.
* Ability to design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure As Code methodologies.
* Familiarity with scripting and configuration management to automate deployment processes.
* Understanding of network, storage, and security considerations in cloud environments.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* Equivalent education is required.

**Responsibilities**

* Build Agentic AI solutions for IT Operations leveraging Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine to support reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool invocation, multi-step investigation, recommendations, and operational decision-making
* Develop autonomous and semi-autonomous remediation solutions incorporating policy controls, identity and access verification, risk assessment, Human-in-the-Loop approvals, rollback, recovery validation, auditability, and feedback loops
* Connect AIOps platforms with ITSM/CMDB, observability, CI/CD, cloud-management, knowledge, security, automation platforms, and enterprise APIs, including ServiceNow or similar tools
* Oversee enterprise architecture reviews, solution assurance, design authority decisions, non-functional requirements, security, resilience, scalability, operational governance, and technical leadership across Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform, Operations, and AI teams
* Head RFP/RFI/RFQ efforts and pre-sales solutioning, covering technical discovery, solution architecture, transformation strategy, estimations, staffing models, implementation roadmaps, assumptions, risks, dependencies, TCO analysis, and technical proposal creation
* Interact with senior customer and executive stakeholders, run architecture workshops and solution defenses, and partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Practice, and Commercial teams to craft technically sound and competitive solutions

**Requirements**

* 18-25 years of overall IT experience, with substantial background in Enterprise/Solution Architecture, Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, IT Operations, Automation, or AIOps
* Deep experience building large-scale AIOps and intelligent operations platforms, covering observability, anomaly detection, event correlation, noise reduction, service-impact analysis, AI-assisted RCA, remediation, and operational automation
* Strong command of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), including enterprise cloud architecture, security, identity, networking, governance, resilience, and scalability
* Direct architecture experience with at least one Agentic AI ecosystem, such as Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine/Google ADK
* Solid grasp of Agentic AI architectures, including reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, RAG/knowledge grounding, context and memory, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation, Human-in-the-Loop processes, guardrails, and policy enforcement
* Background in designing autonomous/self-healing operations, event-driven remediation, workflow orchestration, ITSM integration, operational governance, and secure interactions between AI agents and enterprise systems
* Strong Python skills for building Agentic AI solutions, APIs, integrations, automation, telemetry processing, orchestration, and rapid prototyping
* Track record in RFP/RFI solutioning, pre-sales architecture, technical proposal development, estimations, solution defense, executive stakeholder engagement, and technical leadership across large enterprise transformation programs

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to multiple major cloud platforms along with familiarity with enterprise observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic
* Working knowledge of LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Google ADK, MCP, A2A, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs
* Experience with SRE, FinOps, cloud economics, capacity optimization, predictive operations, and managed-services solutioning
* Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture, AI, Enterprise Architecture, SRE, ITIL, or TOGAF

* Strong exposure to enterprise B2B sales environments
* Experience working with senior leaders in matrix organizations
* Proven track record of managing end-to-end program lifecycle (planning → adoption → impact)

**Core Skills & Capabilities**

* Strategic translation: Converts strategy into actionable execution
* Program management rigor: Strong in planning, tracking, risk management
* Commercial acumen: Understands pipeline, bookings, forecasting, margin
* Data-driven mindset: Uses dashboards and insights to drive action
* Stakeholder management: Influences without authority across levels

* Change management: Drives adoption during transformation initiatives
* Preferred Skills
* Experience in enterprise technology (cloud, storage, SaaS, infrastructure)
* Familiarity with Salesforce, pipeline analytics, dashboards
* Exposure to MEDDICC, solution selling, partner-led growth
* Experience supporting leadership events and execution cadences in APAC
* Success Metrics
* Programs successfully land and scale in India with measurable adoption
* Sales teams demonstrate clear behavior change and execution discipline
* Dashboards provide actionable insights and early risk detection
* Strong field feedback loop improves program effectiveness
* India contributes scalable best practices across APAC

Job Responsibilities

* Establish and lead the Field Excellence organization to foster a high-performance sales culture, driving consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the sales organization.
* Lead transformation initiatives aimed at enhancing sales effectiveness through strong leadership, coaching, and change management practices.
* Design, implement, and continuously optimize sales processes to improve execution across geographically distributed teams, leveraging performance measurement and stakeholder feedback.
* Partner with executive leadership to align on strategic priorities, key programs, roadmaps, and the execution of sales strategies and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with the Worldwide Chief Customer Office (WW CCO) and APAC leadership teams to drive successful program implementation and adoption.

Program Management & Execution

* Develop and execute launch plans across Areas, Countries, Segments, and Districts based on program requirements and organizational priorities.
* Identify and engage key program stakeholders, including Sales, Marketing, Channel Partners, Presales, Sales Operations, Professional Services, Finance, Business Desk, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams.

* Establish management system data points, including pipeline goals, booking targets, revenue metrics, and adoption indicators, to support execution and governance.

Governance & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Integrate program outcomes into existing sales management systems and encourage stakeholder-driven insights to improve effectiveness.
* Develop and maintain a structured feedback mechanism to assess program adoption, critical success factors, business impact, and areas requiring course correction.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to the Global CCO team to support ongoing optimization and scalability of initiatives.
* Drive continuous program improvement by identifying enhancements to processes, tools, communication strategies, and execution frameworks.
* Enable agile decision-making by monitoring program performance and recommending adjustments when results differ from expected outcomes.
* Ensure alignment and coordination across multiple concurrent initiatives, including product launches, professional services programs, renewals, customer success initiatives, and learning services.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Work collaboratively across all business functions to ensure programs are aligned with organizational goals, strategic priorities, and revenue objectives.
* Serve as a central point of coordination, governance, and support, ensuring consistent execution, communication, and stakeholder engagement across the organization.
* Promote best practices, operational rigor, and a culture of continuous improvement to maximize business impact and sales productivity.

With more than 14,000 team members and over 60 locations globally, WWT's culture—grounded in core values and leadership philosophies—has been recognized by Fortune® and Great Place to Work for its commitment to innovation, trust and creating a great place to work for all. WWT provides products and services to large enterprise, global service provider and public sector clients in up to 130 countries across six continents. Softchoice, a World Wide Technology company, supports commercial and SMB markets in the U.S. and Canada.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

**Job Summary:**

As a Presales Consultant/Consulting Systems Engineer (CSE), you will be partnering with Client Executives / Client and Account Managers to provide the technical Pre-Sales work for customers across the country and Global Finance customers operating out of India. No two days will be the same as our broad offerings include Infrastructure Modernization, Multicloud Architecture, Network and Security Transformation, Digital Strategy and fast changing AI solution among others. With our Advanced Technology Center (https://www.wwt.com/atc) at your fingertips for briefings, training, workshops, demos and POC's you'll be delivering best in class results for your customers.
