5e75168d.title: FBS SR Solutions Engineer Guidewire
5e75168d.description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

**What to expect on your journey with us:**

* A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
* Continuous learning and development

A Lead Engineer role responsible for technical direction across multiple Guidewire initiatives and teams. The individual is a recognized subject matter expert who influences architecture, delivery strategy, and engineering standards. Owns technical outcomes beyond any single workstream; demonstrates end-to-end system thinking; influences direction across multiple teams; recognized SME; partners with Product, Architecture, and Delivery leadership; balances delivery speed with long-term operational stability.

Key Responsibilities

* Design & Architecture — Leads solutioning for the complex, cross-functional initiatives; sets architectural direction; ensures enterprise-wide adherence to Guidewire standards.
* Development & Delivery — Oversees development quality and delivery across multiple large-scale initiatives; establishes engineering best practices organization-wide.
* Technical Leadership — Serves as the primary technical authority across assigned domains and teams; drives technical direction and continuous improvement at scale; resolves the highest-complexity dependency and risk issues.
* Production Stability — Owns resolution strategy for critical, cross-system production incidents; drives proactive reliability and performance initiatives across the platform.
* Stakeholder Engagement — Advises leadership on technical risk, tradeoffs, and roadmap decisions; represents engineering in enterprise design forums. Communication must be concise, clear, and free of ambiguity.
* Talent Development — Builds organizational Guidewire capability through coaching, reusable assets, and technical standards; develops future technical leaders.

 **Requirements**  

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, or technology program leadership.
* Full English Fluency
* **Extensive Guidewire Insurance Suite with deep Policy Center expertise (MUST),** sustained P&C domain experience; proven track record leading complex
* People Leadership background, MUST
* **This role requires some overlapping with the US Time zone: A few hours, 2-3hrs a day**

Technical Skills

* Advanced Guidewire configuration and Gosu, Integration Framework, REST/SOAP, Java/J2EE, Spring, SQL/Oracle, batch/event-driven patterns, CI/CD, advanced performance tuning and troubleshooting. - Advanced (7+ Years)
* Deep experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform (JDP)
* Earnix rating/pricing engine integration; cloud-based architecture expertise. - Advanced (7+ Years)
* Guidewire Certified Specialist – PolicyCenter Configuration and Insurance Suite Integration; additional Guidewire Cloud Certifications preferred. - Advanced (7+ Years) Mandatory
* AI Automation Implementation, Claude ai, Claude Agents

  
**Benefits**

This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development

**Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures**

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

* **Personal Data Processing:** The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.
* **Legal Authorization to Work:** Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.

Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer
53bf8952.description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
  
  
As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
  
  
We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
  
  
If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
  
  
Let’s build what’s next, together.
  
  
As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. This is a highly client-facing role that combines strong communication and consultative skills with hands-on technical execution.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to understand business requirements, define the scope of work, conduct solution reviews, and deliver customized solutions using APIs, conversational AI, automation platforms, and emerging AI development tools.
  
  
The ideal candidate is confident in customer interactions, able to convince and influence stakeholders, and comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, and reusable technical artifacts.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement chatbot, conversational agent, and AI-powered solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, explain technical concepts, present solutions, and build confidence in the proposed approach.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, solution reviews, feasibility analyses, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept discussions.
* Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions, implementation plans, and scopes of work.
* Use AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, and similar AI platforms to accelerate solution design, implementation, coding, prototyping, and documentation.
* Create and maintain AI-generated or AI-assisted technical artifacts, including prototypes, workflows, reusable skills, integrations, code components, documentation, and solution accelerators.
* Integrate and configure CPaaS products, including: Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Marketing automation solutions, Conversational agent and chatbot platforms
* Utilize REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and other integration capabilities to extend solution functionality.
* Work with JavaScript, C++, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.
* Support solution implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing technical consulting and post-implementation support to ensure client satisfaction and optimal solution performance.
* Stay up to date with SaaS, conversational AI, generative AI, automation, and CPaaS trends, and apply relevant best practices.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C++, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  
  
No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.
  
  
**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other part of one's identity.**
Read more about our hiring process.

5d2df3bd.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
5d2df3bd.description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You'll own a portfolio of our most strategic accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

085404e4.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Generative AI
085404e4.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

6816da19.title: Architect

Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

* Monitoring & Management Tools — Deploy and support network and security monitoring/management tools, ensuring visibility and proactive issue detection.
* Documentation Ownership — Prepare and update HLDs, LLDs, operational processes, and technical documentation for ongoing and new deployments.
* Sev-1/MIM Incident Support — Provide expert support during incidents to ensure resolution within SLA and minimize business impact.
* Root Cause Analysis — Perform RCA based on OEM inputs and internal investigation, ensuring corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Continuous Improvement — Identify improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements for network and security infrastructure.
* Tool Evaluation — Evaluate new tools and technologies (automation platforms, observability suites, AI-driven NMS), produce recommendations and support effort estimation for new project opportunities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with global IT teams, OEMs, vendors, partners, and service providers to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
* Training & Knowledge Transfer — Provide technical training and mentorship to L1/L2 operations teams to uplift capability and reduce escalations.

You are ready to revolutionize your career and the world of technology with an iconic company. Now is the time to take the reins on this exciting opportunity.

* Represents a product in architectural governance bodies

* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Proficient in coding in one or more languages
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle, including agile practices such as CI/CD, application resiliency, and security

* Experience developing microservices, packaged into AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service and/or Elastic Container Service, and deployed to EC2 instances
* Experience writing Terraform scripts and deploying in AWS production environment

25ac8247.title: Sr. Cloud Engineer
25ac8247.description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**

Job Description:

The Senior Cloud Engineer designs, builds, automates, and supports secure, scalable, and resilient cloud platforms on AWS. This role partners with Cloud Operations, Information Security, DevOps, application engineering, database, and architecture teams to deliver reliable infrastructure and enable efficient software delivery. The position is accountable for AWS infrastructure engineering, Amazon EKS and container platforms, Terraform-based infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, cloud networking, security guardrails, observability, and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  

* Design, implement, and support secure, scalable, highly available AWS cloud infrastructure that aligns with enterprise architecture, security, and operational standards.
* Engineer and manage containerized platforms using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence across production environments.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, creating reusable modules, automation frameworks, and standardized deployment patterns that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
* Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and related DevOps tools to enable automated testing, security validation, deployment, and release management.
* Architect and support AWS networking solutions including VPCs, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Route 53, VPN connectivity, and load balancing services to ensure secure and resilient connectivity.
* Implement cloud security controls, governance standards, and compliance requirements through IAM, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies (SCPs), KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud platform reliability through observability, incident response, root cause analysis, disaster recovery planning, backup strategies, and operational automation.
* Collaborate with Application Development, DevOps, Security, Database, and Cloud Operations teams to deliver cloud solutions, support modernization initiatives, establish engineering standards, and drive continuous improvement across the cloud platform.

Required Qualifications

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of infrastructure, cloud engineering, or platform engineering experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience supporting enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Hands-on experience building and managing Kubernetes platforms, preferably Amazon EKS.
* Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Strong understanding of DevOps, GitOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
* Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Experience supporting highly available, production-grade cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Include qualifications that would be beneficial but are not required for consideration.

* Experience implementing enterprise observability and monitoring solutions using Datadog, including infrastructure monitoring, application performance monitoring (APM), logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics.
* Experience designing and supporting AWS networking architectures utilizing Transit Gateway (TGW), Cloud WAN, Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, and hybrid-cloud connectivity solutions.
* Experience establishing API management standards using Amazon API Gateway, including authentication, authorization, throttling, monitoring, versioning, and security controls.
* Experience implementing and managing identity and access management solutions using Amazon Cognito, including User Pools, Identity Pools, federation, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and single sign-on (SSO) integrations.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).

**The Accurate Way:**
=====================

We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

**Take ownership.**
===================

Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.

**Be open.**
============

Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

**Stay curious.**
=================

Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

**Work as one.**
================

Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

**Equal opportunities**
=======================

Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

**Special Notice:**
===================

Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.

* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

* Infrastructure and deployment architecture

What We Are Looking For

* 3–7 years of experience in
  **Solutions Architecture, Technical Architecture, Software Architecture, AI Engineering, or related roles**
  .
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture and system design.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Strong client-facing and communication skills.
* Experience working with engineering teams and leading technical discussions.
* Experience creating architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Ability to estimate projects and contribute to proposals/SOWs.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment.
* Strong ownership mentality and willingness to get hands-on when required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with international clients, particularly US, UK, Canada, Australia, or UAE markets.
* Experience in an AI consulting, software engineering, digital transformation, or technology services company.
* Experience with enterprise architecture.
* Experience in pre-sales or solution consulting.
* Experience building AI/LLM proof-of-concepts.
* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Experience with AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft, or other enterprise ecosystems is a plus.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Quality and feasibility of proposed solutions.
* Successful conversion of technical opportunities into projects.
* Client satisfaction and technical credibility.
* Accuracy of solution estimates and project scope.
* Quality of architecture documentation.
* Successful delivery of AI-powered solutions.
* Reusability of architecture patterns and accelerators.
* Reduction in solution/design turnaround time.
* Contribution to revenue through solution consulting and pre-sales.
* Adoption of modern AI-first engineering practices.

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

At Sapiogen AI, you won't simply be designing software architectures.

You will help define how
**AI-first software engineering is delivered to modern businesses.**

You will have the opportunity to:

* Work on real-world AI and enterprise transformation projects.
* Interact directly with international clients and business leaders.
* Work across AI, cloud, data, automation, and software engineering.
* Influence architecture and technology decisions from the early stages.
* Build reusable AI solution accelerators.
* Work closely with the founding team.
* Grow into senior leadership responsibilities as the company scales.

Career Growth

This role has a potential growth path toward:

**Solutions Architect → Senior Solutions Architect → Principal Architect → Head of Engineering / CTO**

depending on performance, leadership ability, technical depth, and contribution to Sapiogen AI's growth.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are someone who can take a problem like:

**"Our business has this problem. Can AI solve it?"**

and turn it into:

**Business Requirement → AI Strategy → Solution Architecture → Technology Selection → POC → Implementation → Production → Scale**

If you are passionate about
**AI, architecture, consulting, and building technology that creates measurable business outcomes**
, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Join Sapiogen AI and help us build the future of AI-first software engineering.**

eab7414e.title: Solution Architect
eab7414e.description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**
We are looking for a
**Solution Architect**
to lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable enterprise solutions across our digital platforms. This role will provide architectural leadership across multiple products and engineering teams, ensuring that solutions align with enterprise standards, business objectives, and long-term technology strategy.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Solution Architecture
  
  

* Design end-to-end technical solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable.
* Translate business and functional requirements into solution architectures and technical specifications.
* Define application, integration, data, and deployment architectures.
* Evaluate solution alternatives and recommend the most appropriate technology approach.
* Ensure architecture aligns with enterprise standards and long-term technology strategy.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across multiple engineering teams.
* Review solution designs, code, and technical decisions to ensure consistency and quality.
* Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers on architecture principles and best practices.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Promote reusable frameworks, shared services, and platform capabilities.

Cloud Architecture
  
  

* Design cloud-native solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
* Define scalable deployment architectures using containers and Kubernetes where appropriate.
* Ensure solutions are secure, highly available, observable, and cost optimized.
* Guide engineering teams on cloud architecture, networking, security, and operational best practices.

Application Architecture
  
  
**Provide Architectural Leadership For Applications Built Using**

* C#
* .NET / ASP.NET Core
* ReactJS
* REST APIs
* Microservices
* Event-driven architectures
* Messaging platforms
* Distributed systems

Integration & API Design
  
  

* Design secure and scalable API-first solutions.
* Define integration strategies for internal and external systems.
* Establish API governance, versioning, authentication, and documentation standards.
* Review messaging and asynchronous communication patterns.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure architecture follows secure-by-design principles.
* Incorporate authentication, authorization, encryption, and secrets management into solution designs.
* Apply industry security standards and secure coding practices.
* Support compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.

Engineering Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Engineering Managers to support engineering delivery.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to estimate complexity and define implementation roadmaps.
* Participate in backlog refinement and technical planning activities.
* Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

Architecture Governance
  
  

* Establish architecture principles, standards, and design guidelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical design reviews.
* Ensure consistency across products and engineering teams.
* Drive technical debt management and modernization initiatives.

Generative AI & AI-Ready Architecture
  
  

* Design integration patterns for Generative AI and LLM capabilities across products, including Azure OpenAI Service, Copilot Studio, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Establish governance standards and guardrails for the responsible, secure, and compliant adoption of AI across the platform.
* Evaluate Generative AI and AI/ML platform components and recommend adoption strategies aligned with business and technology objectives.
* Define AI-ready application and data architectures that support LLM integration, vector search, and semantic retrieval patterns.
* Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate architecture documentation, ADR production, and design artefact creation.
* Stay current with Azure AI platform capabilities and guide teams on their effective and responsible adoption.

Architecture & Design
  
  

* Microservices
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
* Clean Architecture
* SOLID Principles
* Event-Driven Architecture
* CQRS (preferred)
* Design Patterns
* API-first Design
* Distributed Systems
* High Availability and Disaster Recovery

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* BE/B.Tech degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Solution Architecture or Technical Architecture.
* Proven experience designing enterprise-scale applications using Microsoft technologies.
* Strong expertise in Azure cloud architecture and modern application design.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure cloud architecture and modern application design.
* Experience designing solutions using:

+ C#
+ .NET / ASP.NET Core
+ ReactJS
+ REST APIs
+ Microservices
+ Event-driven architectures
+ Distributed systems

* Strong understanding of:

+ Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
+ SOLID Principles
+ Clean Architecture
+ API-first Design
+ High Availability and Disaster Recovery concepts

* Experience defining architecture standards, governance frameworks, and reusable design patterns.
* Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns and API governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-204, AZ-400).
* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms.
* Experience with SaaS platforms and multi-tenant architectures.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and cloud-native modernization initiatives.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) and their role in accelerating architecture and delivery workflows.
* Experience designing solutions within a medical device, hearing aid, or regulated healthcare environment is a strong advantage. Familiarity with regulated software architecture requirements — including software classification, design documentation, and requirements traceability — will be highly valued.
* Understanding of ISO 13485 Quality Management Systems and how QMS obligations influence architecture decisions — including audit trail design, data integrity controls, electronic records management, and alignment with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 or EU MDR 2017/745 for regulatory submissions.
* Awareness of risk management principles under ISO 14971 and their architectural implications, including hazard identification, risk mitigation through system design, and residual risk documentation for software components in safety-critical medical applications.

Personal Competencies
  
  

* Strong architectural and strategic thinking abilities.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Proven mentoring and technical coaching skills.
* Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and functions.
* Customer-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on quality, scalability, and continuous improvement.

Who we are
  
  
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**
WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

b59ac078.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
b59ac078.description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

44582b87.title: Solution Architect (Remote)
44582b87.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional
**Solution Architect.**
****About RainFocus****
RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market — it will be challenging, fun and exciting.
  
  
****Role Summary****
The Solution Architect (SA) is a critical member of the RainFocus Client Success organization and the senior-most technical resource within the implementation consulting IC track. Once an implementation begins, the SA owns the overall architecture of the client's event program — aligning platform design and configuration with the client's strategic business objectives and ensuring that the implemented solution is scalable, innovative, and built to last. Solution Architects are trusted advisors to executive-level client stakeholders. They lead discovery and solution design, guide complex integrations, provide oversight across multi-event portfolios, and serve as technical thought leaders within the Client Success organization. Beyond their own engagements, they mentor Solution Consultants, contribute to process and methodology improvement, and represent RainFocus's implementation expertise through thought leadership and client advocacy.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the overall solution architecture for client implementations. Take full ownership of the architectural design for assigned client event programs — leading solution design that considers client requirements, system integrations, scalability, and technical feasibility. Design complex, innovative, and scalable solutions that maximize the value of the RainFocus platform for each client
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive client stakeholders. Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-suite client stakeholders — understanding their strategic objectives and aligning RainFocus solutions with long-term business goals. Lead strategic discovery sessions and consultations that uncover client needs and identify opportunities for platform-driven improvement
* Lead solution design and drive platform adoption. Lead the end-to-end solution design process — collaborating closely with Solution Consultants and technical teams to ensure successful implementation. Drive adoption of RainFocus platform capabilities to maximize client value and strengthen long-term partnership
* Provide oversight across the client implementation portfolio. Ensure adherence to project timelines, quality standards, and client expectations across the full portfolio of client events. Collaborate with project managers and leadership to define project scope, resource allocation, and deliverable expectations. Ensure thorough QA and propose alternative solutions when gaps or inefficiencies are identified
* Lead discovery calls, post-conference reviews, and client communications. Own and facilitate key client-facing conversations — including strategic discovery sessions, post-conference reviews, and milestone reporting — ensuring continuity, transparency, and growth across the client relationship
* Mentor and develop Solution Consultants. Provide active mentorship, expertise, and best practice guidance to Solution Consultants and other team members — fostering a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development within the implementation team
* Contribute to thought leadership and process improvement. Share insights through whitepapers, social media, and conference presentations. Conduct case studies focused on lessons learned and present findings to leadership. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve consulting processes, methodologies, and knowledge sharing across the organization

**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of software implementation experience, with deep expertise implementing SaaS platforms for enterprise-level clients, 3-5 years within SaaS event technology, preferrably RainFocus experience
* Demonstrated track record of gathering, documenting, and translating complex requirements, configurations, and integrations across multiple systems
* Proven ability to own overall solution architecture for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a trusted advisor to executive-level client stakeholders — aligning solutions with long-term business strategy
* Proven track record of creating significant efficiencies through process design, driving adoption, and measuring impact
* Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to adapt to evolving project requirements and client needs while maintaining quality and client satisfaction
* Experience in the event technology, marketing technology, or enterprise B2B SaaS implementation space
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to convey complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
* Collaborative mindset with a demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across cross-functional teams, senior leaders, and clients
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 20%

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, SQL, and/or JSON for advanced customization and integration requirements
* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman
* Background contributing to industry thought leadership — whitepapers, conference presentations, or social media content
* Extensive experience with APIs — designing and implementing complex integrations across enterprise systems
* Demonstrated mentorship track record — developing Solution Consultants or equivalent

implementation professionals.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic solution design. Translates complex, multi-stakeholder client requirements into elegant, scalable architectural solutions — sees the whole picture and designs for long-term success, not just immediate delivery
* Executive client credibility. Earns and sustains trust with C-suite and VP stakeholders — engages as a genuine strategic advisor, not just a platform expert, and shapes the client's vision for what's possible
* Technical depth and breadth. Brings the platform expertise and integration knowledge to design and validate the most complex solutions — and the communication skills to make that expertise accessible to any audience
* Team multiplier. Elevates the capability of the implementation team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and thought leadership — creates lasting organizational value beyond individual engagements
* Thought leadership and innovation. Actively contributes to the industry and organization's knowledge base — shares insights, drives innovation, and positions RainFocus as a leader in enterprise event implementation
* Resilience and adaptability. Performs consistently under pressure across multiple high-profile engagements — adapts quickly to changing circumstances and models composure and solutions-focus for the team

****About RainFocus****
RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our teams serve Fortune 500 companies — including Adobe, Cisco, and IBM — to plan and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events around the world. Those experiences are delivered through our industry-leading software platform, combining powerful business intelligence with seamless event operations to elevate the attendee experience and accelerate marketing results. As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work at events around the globe.
  
  
**RainFocus Values — FOCUS**
F — Forward-Thinking We challenge the status quo and embrace new ideas. We constantly innovate, look for simpler solutions, and understand that sustained success requires perpetual improvement.
  
  
O — Optimistic We assume positive intent and face challenges with optimism. We adapt when things don't go as planned, practice open communication, and passionately debate to create the right solution.
  
  
C — Customer-Centric We care about and invest in the success of our employees and clients. We are effective, efficient, and consistent. We meet our commitments.
  
  
U — Unified We are a team. Individual contributions to a group effort enable us to succeed. We champion balance, believe in each other, and help every employee grow their career and market value.
  
  
S — Stewards We believe in a high-trust environment where employees bring their best selves to work. Stewardship is everyone's responsibility.
  
  
****What RainFocus Offers****
RainFocus is a people-first company. We offer competitive compensation, outstanding benefits, an immediately vested 401(k), generous PTO, and a collaborative environment where you can grow and take your career to the next level. Come be part of a company that is changing the market — it will be challenging, fun, and exciting
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

94d87263.title: Sr. Pricipal, Architect Solutions
94d87263.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Sr Principal Solution Architect**
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Job Description AND PrinciplE Responsibilities**
Senior Solution Architect will architect and guide delivery of solutions that meet strategic and tactical needs across channels and platforms. Will own the technical roadmap, manage technical risks, ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, and partner with engineering and security teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Senior Solution Architect is also responsible to design technical roadmap and processes. Design and develop change resilient application code and execute robust and effective testing. Manage project execution to ensure expected business requirements and related benefits are delivered within appropriate time/budget parameters with a product mindset. Comply with Technology mandates as they relate to methodology, process, and compliance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & Solution Design
  
  

* Architect solutions to meet strategic/tactical technical needs; drive end-to-end solution design for initiatives and enhancements.
* Ensure non-functional requirements are incorporated into overall solution architecture (e.g., reliability, performance, maintainability, supportability).
* Define interactions between systems/components to optimize functional coverage and integration.

Roadmap, Risk & Standards
  
  

* Create and maintain a technical capability roadmap; own technical risks and mitigation approaches associated with features and technologies.
* Ensure alignment with architectures defined within the division and across the enterprise; ensure enterprise technical standards are met.
* Evaluate technologies/products/solutions and recommend introduction, retirement, or phase-out aligned to roadmap and enterprise direction.

Security & Governance
  
  

* Coordinate and address security architecture requirements in partnership with enterprise security teams.
* Support governance/approval readiness by ensuring architecture diagrams reflect implemented reality; ensure monitoring/logging posture and enterprise pipeline usage evidence is in place when required.

Engineering Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Lead developers in creation/review of new or enhanced software and provide technical guidance through design and implementation decisions.
* Engage business partners to understand requirements; translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with Business Architects/Product teams to ensure technical architecture supports business objectives.
* Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure technical standards are defined (as needed) and implemented by the multiple Agile teams in accounting

**Qualifications/ Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 15+ years of significant experience in solution architecture and delivery in complex environments (multi-team, cross-functional).
* 5+ years in Finance domain, 2+ in Investment domain within Finance. Custody domains experience a huge plus

**Core Skills**

* Strong solution design skills across application/integration/data/platform layers; ability to make tradeoffs and drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, decision-making, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks under timelines.
* Ability to drive alignment to enterprise standards and ensure maintainability/supportability of solutions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Experience in modern delivery methods (Agile) and guiding engineering teams through architecture and design decisions.
* Proven skills in building massive scale Cloud Native streaming apps that are resilient and elastically scalable and have built-in redundancy.
* Experience coordinating security architecture and compliance expectations for enterprise solutions.

**Experience In Tech Stacks**

* Experience in programming languages (preferably Java) with hands-on coding
* Experience in Azure Cloud, Terraform. Microservices (Container, Docker, Kubernetes, Cosmos DB), Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Warehouse, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL.
* Azure DevOps - GIT, CI/CD Pipeline / GitActions
* Azure Security and Governance - Manage Identity, SAS, Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Application Gateway, Application Security Group, Web App Security, Dynamic Data Masking
* Proven problem solving and organizational skills with strong interpersonal and team management skills

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

24e84152.title: Senior Forward Deployed Architect, Generative AI
24e84152.description:
**Job Description**
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
NVIDIA is looking for a Forward Deployed Architect to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance across AI Accelerator engagements with AI Native organizations, NeoCloud Providers, and ISVs. You'll advise on architecture and integration, define what good looks like, and bring learnings back to inform the DSX product roadmap. This role is engaged when standard product capabilities are not enough and the work needs to be specialized. Curious about novel hardware before it has a playbook? Excited to define how new platforms get used at scale? Our team works alongside customers and partners on infrastructure problems no one has solved yet, helping teams adopt NVIDIA technology the right way and shaping how new AI workloads get deployed.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Cross-Account Technical Leadership. Provide architectural direction across strategic engagements where standard capabilities are not enough and advanced implementation, optimization, or integration customization is needed.
* Outcome-Focused Implementation. Help customers integrate the right components to deliver on their outcomes. Where DSX software fits, advise on adopting it the right way. Where it doesn't, help them succeed with the right alternative and bring the gap back to product and engineering.
* Hands-On Technical Leadership. Dive into complex technical challenges hands-on when needed to solve critical problems, validate architectures, or prove out solutions.
* Strategic Initiative Ownership. Lead technically demanding programs end to end, including third-party performance benchmarking across hardware and workloads.
* Pattern Identification and Knowledge Sharing. Identify common challenges and solution patterns across engagements. Share findings with internal teams and the broader AI community.
* Technical Standardization. Develop standardized approaches, reference architectures, and structured guidance rooted in patterns from successful engagements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partner with product, engineering, and other customer-facing NVIDIA teams so what we learn in the field informs internal strategy and capabilities.
* Strategic Architecture. Design technical strategies for advanced AI workloads (distributed training, large-scale inference, model and pipeline optimization, MLOps) that apply across multiple customers and partners.
* New Hardware Enablement. Help develop new infrastructure patterns and playbooks for the latest NVIDIA hardware as it lands with customers and partners.

What we need to see
  
  

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in technical roles such as solutions architecture, ML engineering, technical product management, or technical consulting across multiple customers or projects. Alternatively, 5+ years of specialist-level experience working at the frontier of AI infrastructure.
* Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Systems thinking with the ability to understand customer outcomes and translate them into clear technical requirements and architectures.
* Willingness to prototype, implement, validate, and troubleshoot hands-on when needed to solve critical problems or prove out approaches.
* A solid technical foundation in the technologies AI infrastructure is built on, especially Linux systems administration.
* A self-directed learner who can ramp on brand new technologies and unfamiliar technical domains independently.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and multi-functional collaborators.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
  
  

* Solutions architecture or technical consulting background across multiple customer engagements simultaneously, with experience bringing novel AI hardware or frameworks to production with frontier AI Native organizations, hyperscalers, NeoClouds, or ISVs.
* A foundational cloud or distributed systems background built at hyperscaler scale.
* A public technical voice: blog posts, talks, open-source contributions, or reference work that shows depth and opinion.
* Hands-On Technical Expertise in one or more of: NVIDIA Stack (CUDA, NeMo, Triton, TensorRT, NIM, DGX Cloud, and the broader DSX software portfolio), Inference Systems (large-scale inference with frameworks like vLLM and SGLang, prefill-decode disaggregation, performance optimization across hardware), Training Systems (distributed training, model and pipeline optimization, open-source generative AI frameworks), Infrastructure (SLURM, Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, distributed computing frameworks, rack-scale systems, multiple CSP or NCP cloud environments), and Observability and Automation (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, GPU performance monitoring).

**What We Offer**
