cc621f96.title: Solutions Architect- IP
cc621f96.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Solutions Architect to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* The technical face to enterprise customers — scoping deployments, designing tenant configurations, and getting customers live fast (same-day with Desktop Intercept).
* You're selling and deploying a platform that combines voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI — technology that changes monthly — so you learn constantly and demo fearlessly
* Startup environment: the deal, the deployment, and the product are all moving at once, and you thrive in that.

**What you'll own:**

* Pre-sales and deployment architecture
* Tenant configuration and plugin enablement design
* Customer integration scoping (CCaaS / CRM / SIP)
* live demos that win — show-me applies to customers too
* The customer's voice back into Product and Engineering
* Your committed go-live timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with grit and a closer's instinct — you like winning, and a signed customer going live is your scoreboard
* Show-me mentality: you'd rather run the live demo than present the slide
* You adapt fast when the product shifts under you (it will, weekly), love new technology, and use AI tools daily — including in your own demo and scoping workflow
* A do-er who owns the messy middle instead of escalating it
* A team player who translates in both directions: business requirements into technical needs for engineering, platform capability into business value for the customer.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 8+ years of solutions architecture/sales engineering in contact-center, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS.
* Technical enough to design an integration on a whiteboard and credible enough to own a CTO conversation — you keep the respect of senior engineers on both sides of the table.
* Knows CCaaS / CTI, SIP / RTP, and CRM landscapes cold.
* Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack — LLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, transcription/translation — deep enough to answer the customer's AI architecture and data-security questions without phoning home.
* Has taken enterprise customers live and owned the messy middle — network quirks, security reviews, procurement, the works.
* Hands-on enough to configure a tenant, read an API payload, and debug a customer integration in real time — a troubleshooter, not a talker: when the pilot breaks at 4pm, you isolate it.
* Understands event-driven platform architecture well enough to scope custom integrations accurately — what's config, what's a connector, what's a feature request.
* Deployment playbook craft — turns every go-live into a repeatable playbook so the second customer is faster than the first; this is how one SA scales.
* Enterprise security fluency — comfortable in InfoSec reviews (SOC 2, data residency, PII/redaction, AI data-usage questions); AI deals die here without it.
* Competitive positioning depth — knows the CCaaS/agent-assist landscape and can architect around a competitor's incumbency.
* POC discipline — scopes pilots with clear success criteria and exit dates, so pilots convert instead of drifting.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

b7122d82.title: Technical Account Manager
b7122d82.description:
**Company Description:**

Sofiotic is a cybersecurity company focused on making security a core enabler of innovation rather than a barrier. Founded by industry veterans, Sofiotic replaces fragmented security tools with a unified intelligence platform used by global enterprises across diverse sectors. The platform streamlines vulnerability management, product security, ASPM, and compliance management, supported by full-stack security consulting services. By consolidating security data into a single interface, Sofiotic simplifies workflows, improves collaboration across engineering teams, and accelerates remediation efforts. The company is committed to helping organizations continuously reduce their attack surface in a fast-evolving, AI-driven landscape.

**About the Role:**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the dedicated technical advisor and security partner for our enterprise customers. Our platform serves as the central nervous system for modern AppSec and ProdSec. In this role, you will bridge the gap between SecOps/CISO organizations and Product/Engineering teams. You will guide customers through technical deployment, help them operationalize vulnerability remediation workflows, map risk governance frameworks, and ensure they achieve measurable risk reduction and fast time-to-value across their software development lifecycle (SDLC).

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Trusted ASPM Advisory

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients enterprise security architects, AppSec leads, DevSecOps engineers, and CISOs.
* Advise customers on establishing AppSec maturity programs, prioritizing remediation backlogs (reachability analysis, EPSS/CVSS scores, business criticality), and enforcing automated security guardrails.
* Partner with customer engineering and security champions to design custom risk scoring, triage policies, deduplication logic, and SLA-driven remediation rules.

2. Deployment, CI/CD Integrations & Data Ingestion

* Guide end-to-end integration of VTrimax (ASPM) platform across customer environments:
* Code Repositories & SCM: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket.
* CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins etc.
* Security Scanners & Formats: SAST, DAST, SCA, Container Security, Cloud Security (IaC/CSPM), and standard formats like SARIF, CycloneDX, and SPDX.
* Issue Trackers platforms

3. Escalations, Root-Cause Analysis & Technical Advocacy

* Manage high-priority technical escalations (ingestion failures, scanner API timeouts, parsing errors, sync mismatches) alongside engineering and product teams.
* Translate complex edge cases and false-positive/deduplication issues into structured technical specifications for the internal engineering and product roadmaps.
* Conduct architecture reviews, release briefings, and hands-on runbook sessions for new platform features and threat detection capabilities.

4. Adoption, Business Reviews & Growth

* Monitor key customer telemetry: scanner coverage, triage completion rates, mean-time-to-remediate (MTTR), and pipeline gate compliance.
* Lead technical discussions during Quarterly/Executive Business Reviews (QBRs/EBRs), demonstrating tangible AppSec ROI and vulnerability posture improvements.
* Identify expansion opportunities (new business units, additional repository onboarding, enterprise-wide rollout) in collaboration with Customer Success and Sales.

**Qualifications & Experience Required:**

* Experience: 2–6+ years in a customer-facing technical role (TAM, DevSecOps/Security Solutions, Customer Success Engineer) at a cybersecurity, AppSec, DevOps, or enterprise developer-tooling company.
* AppSec & DevSecOps Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the SDLC and application security testing categories: SAST, DAST, SCA, Secrets Detection, Container Scanning, and IaC.
* Deep familiarity with vulnerability classification and standards: CWE, CVE, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP Top 10, and SBOM standards (CycloneDX, SPDX).
* Hands-on experience with SARIF schemas and vulnerability deduplication/correlation concepts.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and enterprise identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, SSO).

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive base salary + performance bonus + equity options in a fast-growing cybersecurity startup company.
* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance.
* Flexible remote work setup and home office stipend.
* Annual budget for technical certifications, AppSec training, and attendance at top security conferences (e.g., DEF CON, Black Hat, RSA).

About the Company

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.

As an AI Solutions Expert/Specialist, you will own the design, development, and deployment of artificial intelligence solutions that automate and optimize the end-to-end content lifecycle across a global CPG organization. You will work at the intersection of AI engineering and content operations — connecting proofs of concept, MVPs, and enterprise-grade platforms to streamline how content is generated, organized, and delivered across every consumer and professional touchpoint.

* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI Foundry, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and Azure Cognitive/AI Services

* Strong application development background — ability to build, ship, and maintain production-grade software, not just prototypes or notebooks

* Proven experience with LLMs including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic architectures

* Experience with generative AI for image, video, and/or multi-modal content creation

* Solid experience designing and operating data pipelines in Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Event Grid, or equivalent)

* Proficiency in Python and at least one additional enterprise language (C#, TypeScript, Java)

* Strong understanding of API design, microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AKS), and cloud-native patterns

* Experience deploying AI solutions through the full maturity curve: POC MVP enterprise production

* Hands-on experience with DevOps and MLOps tooling — Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, MLflow, model versioning, drift monitoring, automated retraining, and A/B testing in production

* Working knowledge of database technologies including Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, and data lake architectures (Azure Data Lake, Blob Storage, Azure Synapse)

* Experience building with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen

* Familiarity with front-end and full-stack patterns (React or Angular, FastAPI/Flask backends, serverless architectures) to deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Required Technical Skills:**

Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Search, Azure Document Intelligence, Azure Bot Service

Data Engineering

Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Event Hub / Event Grid, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Data Lake

Deep Agents, Agentic Workflow developments, multi-modal pipelines

**General Business**

Good to Have — Domain & Business Experience.

* Experience working in or with CPG, FMCG, consumer health, or pharmaceutical organizations

* Familiarity with consumer advertising and media production workflows (TV, digital, social, programmatic)

* Exposure to social media content operations, scheduling platforms, and performance analytics

* Understanding of e-commerce product content (product descriptions, A+ content, marketplace listings)

* Awareness of email marketing and CRM-driven personalization tools (Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, or similar)

* Experience with HCP and medical affairs communications in regulated environments

* Experience with PIM and DAM platforms (Salsify, Akeneo, Adobe AEM, Bynder, or similar)

* Exposure to localization and transcreation processes across global markets

* Azure certifications (AI Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Expert, or equivalent)

* Experience managing vendor and agency relationships for AI tooling and creative technology

What You’ll Impact.

4b0dbe4c.description:
Job Description – Azure Cloud Architect

**Experience:**
8–15 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Mandatory Skills:**
Azure Infrastructure, Linux, Cloud Architecture & Design

**Certification:**
Azure Cloud Architect Certification Preferred

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Azure Cloud Architect to design, implement, and support Azure cloud solutions. The candidate must have strong hands-on experience in Azure infrastructure, Linux, cloud architecture, and solution design. The role involves cloud migration, infrastructure optimization, automation, and collaboration with engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Architect, implement, and support cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Design cloud infrastructure and application architectures based on business and technical requirements.
* Develop strategies to migrate applications and workloads to the cloud.
* Automate cloud operations, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment processes.
* Manage cloud deployments within defined budgets and ensure infrastructure SLA compliance.
* Work closely with business leads, product owners, lead architects, and engineers to understand requirements and identify suitable architectural patterns.
* Resolve application-to-platform integration issues related to Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS).
* Research and recommend solutions for Azure data transformation, data connectivity, operational frameworks, and application integration.
* Create and maintain architectural templates, technical designs, implementation plans, and operational documentation.
* Enhance cloud capabilities by developing and implementing reusable cloud application patterns.
* Support engineering teams in adopting cloud-native services and modern application architectures.

Mandatory Skills

* Strong knowledge and practical experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Hands-on experience with
  **Azure Infrastructure and Linux**
  .
* Proven experience in cloud architecture, solution design, and implementation.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud infrastructure components, including:
* Virtual machines and servers
* Cloud networking
* Load balancers
* Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
* Understanding of modern cloud application architecture.
* Exposure to cloud-managed services, Function as a Service (FaaS), containers, and managed databases.
* Experience with cloud migration, infrastructure automation, and deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Azure Cloud Architect certification.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure automation and operational frameworks.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Candidate Requirements

* **Total Experience:**
  7–15 Years
* **Minimum Relevant Experience:**
  4+ Years in cloud architecture/design
* **Primary Cloud Platform:**
  Microsoft Azure
* **Mandatory Technical Skills:**
  Azure Infrastructure, Linux, Architecture/Design
* **Location:**
  Bangalore

**Important:**
Candidates must have hands-on Azure infrastructure experience and prior involvement in architecture and design activities.

5de4f14f.title: AWS DevOps Architect
5de4f14f.description:
**Job Type**
: Full-Time

**Duration**
: Long Term

**Work Preference**
: Onsite

**Experience**
: 10+ Years

**Work Location**
: Pune, Gondia, MH

We are seeking an experienced
**AWS DevOps Architect**
to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong
**AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience**
and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define enterprise
  **AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures**
  .
* Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.
* Architect
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.
* Establish Infrastructure as Code using
  **Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation**
  .
* Design containerized platforms using
  **Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR**
  .
* Define deployment strategies including
  **Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback**
  .
* Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Implement
  **DevSecOps**
  practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.
* Design AWS networking patterns involving
  **VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity**
  .
* Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Implement observability using
  **Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana**
  .
* Design IAM and security models following
  **least-privilege and Zero Trust principles**
  .
* Implement secrets and encryption management using
  **AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS**
  .
* Design solutions for
  **high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity**
  .
* Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.
* Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.
* Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using
  **AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging**
  .
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

**Required Experience**

* **10+ years of overall IT experience**
  with
  **5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience**
  .
* 3+ years in a
  **DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer**
  role.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:
* EC2, S3, IAM, VPC
* Lambda
* ECS/EKS
* ECR
* API Gateway
* Route 53
* ALB/NLB
* CloudWatch and CloudTrail
* Secrets Manager and KMS
* EventBridge, SNS and SQS
* Step Functions
* Strong expertise in
  **Terraform**
  and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with
  **AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **Docker and Kubernetes/EKS**
  .
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using
  **GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild**
  .
* Strong scripting skills using
  **Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell**
  .
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.
* Experience implementing enterprise
  **DevSecOps and security automation**
  .
* Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion.

**Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred**

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

* **Amazon API Gateway**
  for API management and exposure.
* **AWS Lambda**
  for serverless processing and integration.
* **Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS**
  for event-driven integration.
* **AWS Step Functions**
  for workflow orchestration.
* **AWS Transfer Family**
  for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.
* **AWS B2B Data Interchange**
  for EDI transformation and processing.
* **Amazon S3**
  for enterprise file and message storage.
* **AWS Batch**
  for large-scale batch processing.
* **Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow**
  for workflow orchestration.
* Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.

**DevSecOps Responsibilities**

The architect should establish automated controls for:

* SAST/DAST and dependency scanning
* Container image scanning
* Infrastructure vulnerability scanning
* Terraform/IaC security validation
* Secrets detection
* IAM and policy validation
* Automated compliance checks
* Artifact and container security
* Audit logging and traceability

**Role Expectations**

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the
**end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture**
, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes.

This is an
**architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role**
, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

b8ae46cb.title: Security Architect – CSPM / Wiz.io
b8ae46cb.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Architect – CSPM / Wiz.io based in India.**
The Security Architect will lead enterprise cloud security initiatives, helping organizations strengthen their security posture across Microsoft Azure and complex cloud environments.
  
  
This senior-level role combines cloud security architecture, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), technical consulting, and strategic risk mitigation.
  
  
You will leverage Wiz.io capabilities to identify security gaps, assess cloud configurations, and develop actionable remediation strategies.
  
  
The position also integrates AI-powered tools and prompt engineering to improve the quality, accuracy, and efficiency of security assessments and technical documentation.
  
  
Working closely with security teams, business units, and enterprise stakeholders, you will translate complex technical findings into practical security recommendations.
  
  
Your expertise will help organizations adopt cloud security best practices, address evolving threats, and maintain resilient, compliant cloud infrastructures.
  
  
This fully remote opportunity is suited to an experienced cybersecurity professional who combines deep technical knowledge with strong consulting, communication, and leadership skills.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Cloud Security Architecture: Design, evaluate, and oversee secure cloud architectures for large-scale enterprise environments, ensuring alignment with security requirements, business objectives, and industry best practices.
* CSPM and Wiz.io Implementation: Drive the adoption and effective use of Wiz.io capabilities to assess cloud security posture, identify misconfigurations, detect vulnerabilities, and prioritize risks across cloud environments.
* Microsoft Azure Security Assessments: Conduct comprehensive security evaluations of Microsoft Azure infrastructures, identifying configuration weaknesses, access control issues, vulnerabilities, and potential exposure risks.
* Enterprise Security Consulting: Lead cloud security consulting engagements, define project deliverables, manage stakeholder expectations, and provide expert guidance on security architecture and risk reduction.
* Security Assessment and Remediation Planning: Prepare detailed security assessment reports, document findings, prioritize remediation activities, and develop structured implementation roadmaps to address identified risks.
* AI-Enabled Consulting and Documentation: Integrate AI-driven tools into technical consulting workflows to improve research, analysis, documentation, and the delivery of high-quality security recommendations.
* Prompt Engineering and Output Validation: Design, refine, and test prompts used for AI-assisted security analysis and documentation, validating generated outputs for technical accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
* Technical Documentation: Develop clear, comprehensive security architecture documents, assessment reports, technical recommendations, and implementation guidance tailored to enterprise requirements.
* Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary technical liaison between security teams, business units, and other stakeholders, ensuring complex security issues are communicated clearly and effectively.
* Security Best Practices and Continuous Improvement: Promote cloud security best practices, strengthen CSPM processes, and recommend improvements to security frameworks in response to emerging threats and evolving cloud technologies.
* Technical Delivery and Quality Assurance: Ensure that security assessments, consulting deliverables, and remediation recommendations meet established quality standards and support measurable improvements in enterprise cloud security.

**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: At least 10 years of professional experience in cybersecurity, with a strong specialization in cloud security, security architecture, and enterprise security consulting.
* Cloud Security Architecture Expertise: Proven experience designing, reviewing, and implementing security architectures for complex enterprise cloud environments.
* CSPM and Wiz.io Knowledge: Strong understanding of Cloud Security Posture Management principles and practical experience using Wiz.io to evaluate cloud environments, identify risks, and guide remediation efforts.
* Microsoft Azure Security: Demonstrated expertise in Microsoft Azure security assessments, cloud configuration reviews, identity and access management, vulnerability identification, and security control implementation.
* Security Assessment and Risk Management: Experience conducting technical security assessments, interpreting findings, prioritizing risks, and developing actionable remediation plans and implementation roadmaps.
* AI and Prompt Engineering Skills: Advanced ability to design, test, and refine prompts and validate AI-generated technical content for accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
* AI Tool Integration: Experience incorporating AI-powered tools into technical consulting, security analysis, and documentation workflows to improve efficiency without compromising technical quality.
* Technical Writing and Documentation: Strong ability to produce detailed security assessment reports, architecture documentation, remediation plans, and implementation recommendations.
* Consulting and Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated success leading enterprise cloud security engagements, managing stakeholder expectations, coordinating deliverables, and building effective working relationships.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex cybersecurity concepts, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to investigate complex cloud security issues and recommend practical, risk-based solutions.
* Leadership and Ownership: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, take ownership of technical deliverables, and guide stakeholders toward effective security outcomes.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Compensation: Annual salary of approximately ₹24 lakh per annum (₹24 LPA).
* Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from India, offering flexibility in your working environment.
* Senior-Level Technical Impact: Lead enterprise cloud security initiatives and influence security architecture decisions across complex cloud environments.
* Advanced Technology Exposure: Work with Wiz.io, Microsoft Azure, CSPM solutions, and AI-powered tools for technical consulting and documentation.
* Strategic Consulting Experience: Engage with enterprise stakeholders and contribute to security assessments, architecture improvements, and remediation strategies.
* Professional Growth: Further develop your expertise in cloud security architecture, AI-assisted security workflows, risk management, and enterprise cybersecurity consulting.
* Collaborative Environment: Work across security teams and business units to deliver practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
* Full-Time Opportunity: Join a full-time engagement focused on strengthening enterprise cloud security and improving organizational resilience.

**How Jobgether Works**
We use an
**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
  
  
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
  
  
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 4b4a1af1.title: Salesforce Senior Technical Architect (CTA Aspirants)
4b4a1af1.description:
**Description**
The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 14+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect
* Other relevant AI/ML, AI Specialist, or Cloud Architect certifications

**Description**
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations.
  
  
The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Even Better If...**

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

963588d2.title: ServiceNow SOMT Architecture Consultant
963588d2.description:
**ServiceNow SOMT Architecture Consultant**

**Experience:** 8–10 Years (10+ years of overall IT / Solution Architecture experience preferred)  
**Work Mode:** Remote  
**Shift Timing:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST  
**Domain:** Telecom / Fiber Services

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **ServiceNow SOMT Architecture Consultant** with strong expertise in Telecom Service Management, ServiceNow SOMT, and Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing end-to-end telecom service lifecycle solutions, including Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Fulfillment, provisioning, billing, and MACD processes. The role requires strong solution architecture, enterprise integration, and stakeholder management skills, along with the ability to leverage standard ServiceNow capabilities and minimize unnecessary customizations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Telecom SOMT Architecture**

* Design end-to-end ServiceNow SOMT architecture for telecom and fiber services.
* Design Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Fulfillment, provisioning, billing, and service closure workflows.
* Define New Order and MACD (Move, Add, Change, Disconnect) lifecycle processes.
* Establish relationships between products, services, and resources across the telecom service lifecycle.
* Design reusable, scalable, and maintainable telecom fulfillment patterns.
* Define integrations with CRM, CPQ, billing, inventory, network/OSS, and ERP systems.

**2. ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)**

* Design solutions using ServiceNow SPM and Project Portfolio Management capabilities for telecom implementation and delivery initiatives.
* Work with project charters, projects, project tasks, dependencies, milestones, planned versus actual dates, and project status tracking.
* Leverage SPM Epics and related capabilities to manage business initiatives and delivery requirements.
* Align SOMT order and service lifecycle processes with SPM project and delivery management.
* Define the appropriate boundaries between standard SPM functionality, SOMT capabilities, and custom extensions.
* Recommend out-of-the-box ServiceNow capabilities wherever possible to minimize unnecessary customization.

**3. Solution Architecture & Enterprise Integration**

* Develop end-to-end solution architecture, functional architecture, and integration designs.
* Define data flows and integrations across SOMT, SPM, CRM, CPQ, billing, OSS/BSS, ERP, and other enterprise systems.
* Identify gaps between standard ServiceNow capabilities and business requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Ensure architecture designs are scalable, reusable, secure, maintainable, and aligned with ServiceNow best practices.
* Evaluate technical dependencies, integration challenges, and solution risks.
* Drive architecture discussions and collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and enterprise architects.

**4. Stakeholder Management & Solutioning**

* Engage stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical architecture and solution designs.
* Present architecture recommendations, design decisions, and implementation approaches.
* Support solutioning and presales activities, including technical discussions and solution presentations.
* Communicate architectural trade-offs and recommend solutions aligned with business objectives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong experience in IT architecture, solution architecture, or enterprise solution design.
* Hands-on expertise in ServiceNow SOMT / Telecom Service Management.
* Proven experience designing telecom or fiber service lifecycle solutions.
* Strong understanding of Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Cash, Order-to-Fulfillment, and MACD processes.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow SPM, including Projects, Project Tasks, Dependencies, Milestones, Epics, and portfolio/project tracking.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow SOMT and SPM with enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of telecom product, service, and resource lifecycle management.
* Experience in enterprise integrations involving CRM, CPQ, billing, OSS/BSS, inventory, and ERP systems.
* Ability to assess standard ServiceNow functionality versus custom development requirements.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, solution design, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in solutioning and presales activities is highly desirable.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

A solution architecture professional with strong ServiceNow SOMT and telecom domain expertise, capable of designing end-to-end telecom service lifecycle solutions, aligning SOMT with SPM, and leading complex enterprise integration initiatives.

We are conducting a Walk-in Drive in our Mansarovar, Jaipur, Office on Saturday, 24th October. Please find below the detailed job description and let me know your interest.

  

**Who We Are:**

**Celebal Technologies** is a premier software services company specializing in digital transformation and enterprise reinvention, delivering end-to-end results to clients across diverse sectors. Our dynamic suite of advanced solutions built on Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Industry Data Models, Infrastructure & Database Migration, SAP Extend & Innovate, App Modernization, and Enterprise Cloud Integration, positions us at the nexus of traditional enterprise systems and modern cloud innovation. With a global presence spanning the USA, India, APAC, UAE, Europe, and Canada, Celebal Technologies boasts a dedicated workforce of over 3000+ professionals that serve up an impressive client base, including 90% of Fortune 500 companies, guiding them through their transformative digital journeys.

  

**Job Title: Senior Salesforce Solution Architect**

**Location: Jaipur**

**Duration: Fulltime**

**EXPERIENCE: 8+ years**

**ROLE LEVEL: Senior Consultant / Technical Architect / Solution Architect**

**HIRING MODE: Walk-In Hiring Drive**

  

**About the opportunity**

Celebal Technologies is seeking experienced Salesforce professionals to contribute to enterprise transformation, application modernization, and next-generation architecture initiatives. The role requires a deep understanding of CRM business processes, application landscapes, data models, workflows, and integrations, and the ability to translate those capabilities into flexible, scalable future-state solutions.

  

**This is not a conventional Salesforce implementation or administration role.**

  

**Key responsibilities Salesforce assessment and architecture**

* Assess Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, custom objects, metadata, data models, security, workflows, automations, and business processes.
* Review existing Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
* Document the current-state landscape, application dependencies, business rules, data flows, and reusable capabilities.
* Identify modernization opportunities, constraints, and technical risks.

  

**Key responsibilities modernization and solution design**

* Translate Salesforce-based business capabilities into future-state application and integration architectures.
* Design modular applications, reusable services, API strategies, integration patterns, and data architecture components.
* Contribute to technical discovery, solution design, proof-of-concepts, implementation planning, and design reviews.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, developers, data engineers, cloud teams, and business stakeholders.

  

**Key responsibilities — enterprise integration, data and AI**

* Design secure Salesforce integrations with enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and cloud services.
* Apply API-led, synchronous/asynchronous, event-driven, and service-oriented integration patterns.
* Assess data ownership, relationships, quality, migration considerations, and access to CRM business capabilities.
* Support connected enterprise solutions involving modern data platforms, intelligent automation, and AI-driven applications.

  

**Mandatory qualifications and technical skills**

* 8+ years of relevant technology experience with substantial hands-on Salesforce implementation and solution architecture exposure.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud, CRM business processes, objects, relationships, metadata, and permissions.
* Ability to explain and review Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL, and platform customization.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs, middleware, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Understanding of OAuth 2.0, authentication, authorization, API security, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
* Demonstrated ability to assess complex existing applications, map business capabilities, and develop technical architecture documentation.
* Hands-on solution design capability and willingness to participate in implementation, not only advisory work.

  

**Preferred / good-to-have skills**

* Exposure to Azure, cloud-native applications, microservices, and modern application development.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or other enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, or Copilot Studio integrations.
* Understanding of data migration, transformation, enterprise AI, intelligent automation, RAG, or agentic systems.
* Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect credentials.
* Prior Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. Strong architecture fundamentals and learning agility are essential.

  

**Ideal candidate**

* Understands end-to-end Salesforce implementations and the business capabilities they support.
* Can reason about how those capabilities could be redesigned across different platforms and integration boundaries.
* Combines architectural ownership with a practical, builder-oriented approach.
* Is motivated to broaden their expertise into cloud, data, enterprise integration, and AI.

You will help operators and MSSPs secure their own infrastructure (mobile core, Gi/N6 LAN, peering and data centers) and build managed security services for their end customers.

Key Responsibilities

* Act as the trusted technical advisor to service provider accounts, engaging at engineering, architecture and CXO levels.
* Translate business and technical requirements into Fortinet solution architectures, including high-level and low-level designs.
* Deliver product presentations, technical workshops, whiteboard sessions and live demos at customer sites and industry events.

* Position and design Fortinet solutions for use cases such as:
* Mobile core and 4G/5G network security, subscriber and Gi/N6 LAN protection
* Carrier-grade NAT (CGNAT) and large-scale firewalling
* Threat mitigation and protection for AI factories and AI workloads.

16c1dc9a.title: Contact Center Solutions Engineer
16c1dc9a.description:
Voxtron is looking for a technically strong **Contact Center Solutions Engineer to join our Voxvantage team.**

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Contact Center technologies, VoIP/SIP and Linux/Unix environments. The role involves solution implementation, configuration, integration, troubleshooting and technical support of enterprise Contact Center solutions.

Voxvantage is powered by the **Bright Pattern Contact Center platform,** which operates on a Linux/Unix-based environment. Prior Bright Pattern experience is an advantage but is not mandatory. Candidates with strong experience in other enterprise Contact Center platforms and solid Linux/Unix knowledge are encouraged to apply.

  

Key Responsibilities

- Implement, configure and support enterprise Contact Center solutions.

- Configure ACD, IVR, call routing, queues, skills, campaigns, recording, reporting and omnichannel interactions.

- Install, configure and troubleshoot applications in Linux/Unix environments.

- Troubleshoot VoIP and telephony-related issues involving SIP, RTP, SIP trunks, codecs and DTMF.

- Perform system-level troubleshooting using logs, traces and network diagnostic tools.

- Integrate Contact Center solutions with CRM, helpdesk and other enterprise applications.

- Work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and other integration technologies.

- Configure and troubleshoot network-related components including TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls and SSL/TLS certificates.

- Support system upgrades, patches, backup/restore, high availability and disaster recovery activities.

- Perform root-cause analysis for production issues and provide L2/L3 technical support.

- Participate in customer requirement discussions and translate business requirements into technical solutions.

- Support demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (POCs), solution deployment and customer acceptance.

- Coordinate with product vendors, internal development teams and customer IT teams for issue resolution.

  

Mandatory Technical Skills

  

- 4+ years of hands-on experience with **Contact Center / Call Center technologies.**

- Strong understanding of ACD, IVR, call routing, queues, skills-based routing and CTI.

- Good hands-on knowledge of Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting.

- Strong understanding of SIP and VoIP technologies.

- Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls and networking fundamentals.

- Ability to analyse application/system logs and troubleshoot production issues.

- Working knowledge of SQL/databases.

- Basic understanding of APIs and enterprise application integrations.

- Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage:

- Bright Pattern Contact Center

- Genesys

- Avaya

- Cisco Contact Center

- NICE CXone

- Five9 or similar enterprise Contact Center platforms

- Wireshark or other network/SIP troubleshooting tools

- Shell scripting

- REST APIs and JSON

- Virtualization and cloud environments

- High Availability and Disaster Recovery environments

  
  

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is hands-on and technically strong, rather than purely functional or pre-sales oriented.

The candidate should be comfortable working at both the Contact Center application level and the underlying Linux/Unix infrastructure level and should be capable of independently diagnosing complex issues involving applications, telephony, networking and integrations.

• Review existing Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, APIs, and enterprise integrations.

The consultant will assess the client's cloud security posture, review existing technical documentation, validate AI-generated technical outputs, and develop a comprehensive security architecture and detailed implementation design for Wiz.io across Microsoft Azure and SAP environments. The ideal candidate must have strong architectural expertise, practical Wiz.io implementation experience, and the ability to translate technical requirements into actionable security solutions. Key Responsibilities - Review and assess existing project documentation related to CSPM, Wiz.io, and cloud security architecture. - Design and evaluate security architecture for implementing Wiz.io across cloud environments. - Assess cloud configurations, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security risks across Microsoft Azure and SAP environments. - Review, validate, and refine AI-generated technical outputs for accuracy and alignment with security best practices. - Refine AI prompts and provide technical context to improve AI-generated security recommendations. - Develop high-level security architecture and evaluation frameworks for assessing cloud security posture. - Conduct discovery activities to gather technical requirements, existing security controls, and integration dependencies. - Identify security gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities in existing cloud environments. - Prepare detailed Wiz.io implementation design documentation, including architecture, integration requirements, configuration considerations, and recommendations. - Collaborate with client stakeholders to validate requirements and align the proposed architecture with business and security objectives. - Support the transition from discovery and high-level design to detailed implementation design. Mandatory Skills & Qualifications - 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or security architecture. - Strong expertise in Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). - Direct, hands-on experience designing and implementing Wiz.io solutions is mandatory. - Strong understanding of cloud security assessments, configuration management, vulnerability management, and cloud risk identification. - Experience assessing and securing Microsoft Azure environments. - Experience working with or assessing security configurations across SAP environments. - Ability to review technical documentation, evaluate existing architectures, identify security gaps, and develop detailed implementation designs. - Experience translating business and technical requirements into scalable cloud security architecture. - Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. - Ability to work independently in a consulting engagement with a flexible workload. - Availability to overlap with Australian business hours for at least four hours per working day. Good-to-Have Skills - Experience using AI tools for technical consulting, architecture documentation, or security assessments. - Knowledge of prompt engineering and techniques for improving AI-generated technical outputs. - Previous experience with utility, electricity, energy, or other critical infrastructure clients. - Experience delivering cloud security architecture consulting engagements for large enterprises. Engagement Details - Duration: 3 months. - Work Location: Fully remote. - Initial Phase: Part-time discovery, documentation review, requirements gathering, and high-level architecture design. - Workload: Minimum 2 days per week, with the possibility of increasing based on project requirements. - Final Phase: Approximately 1–2 weeks of full-time engagement may be required to complete the detailed implementation design. - Time Zone Requirement: Minimum 4 hours of overlap with Australian business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM Australian local time). Expected Deliverables 1. Assessment and review of existing CSPM and Wiz.io documentation. 2. Validation and refinement of AI-generated technical consulting outputs. 3. Cloud security architecture assessment and high-level design. 4. Documented client requirements, security gaps, risks, and integration dependencies. 5. Detailed Wiz.io implementation design document with architecture recommendations and technical considerations. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a senior Security Architect with proven, hands-on Wiz.io architecture and implementation experience, combined with strong CSPM expertise. The candidate should be comfortable working independently in a consulting environment, validating AI-assisted technical deliverables, and producing enterprise-grade cloud security architecture documentation. Important: Candidates must have direct Wiz.io architecture and implementation experience, along with relevant cloud security assessment expertise. General cybersecurity or Azure security experience without practical Wiz.io experience will not be sufficient. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated resumes highlighting relevant Wiz.io implementation, CSPM, Azure security architecture, and SAP security assessment experience. Contact Details: Email: sonia@achutha.com WhatsApp: 9025372346

65e58211.title: Solution Architect, Public Sector India
65e58211.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.

**Purpose:**

Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.

**India Public Sector Context:**

* Who we serve: central ministries, state governments, PSUs, regulators, smart city and urban bodies, and digital public infrastructure programs.
* Where ServiceNow fits: citizen grievance and service delivery, case management, GRC, IT operations for large government estates, workflow over legacy systems, and AI-assisted operations.
* How deals happen: tender-led (RFP/RFQ, GeM), SI and partner-led bids, price-sensitive evaluation, long sales cycles.
* What shapes the design: data residency, MeitY-empanelled cloud, CERT-In and security audits, the DPDP Act, and Make in India preferences.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Public Sector BD & Sales Leads for the GTM plan for Central and State Ministries, Public Sector Banks and Higher Education / Universities
* Lead architecture sessions with government CIO, IT, and NIC teams, translating program goals into actionable blueprints.
* Own the technical response on RFPs and tenders: compliance matrices, architecture, sizing, and clarifications.
* Build and run proof of concepts and demos across AI, workflow, and integration that prove value in days, not weeks.
* Design within government constraints: hosting, data localisation, security, AI governance, and integration with legacy and national platforms.
* Co-sell with SIs and partners on solution scope, bid strategy, and delivery handoff.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Consultants, Specialists, Product, and Legal on deal strategy and risk.
* Work with regional AI experts to shape and validate AI solutions and proof of concepts.
* Build reusable India public sector assets: reference architectures, AI use-case patterns, an RFP response library, and a compliance FAQ.
* Mentor Solution Consultants on public sector sales motions.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8-10 years of exclusive public sector pre-sales experience (government, PSU, or SI/OEM on government programs).
* Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
* AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.
* Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.
* Depth in enterprise workflow or ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred; fast ramp expected if not), plus integration, API, data, and automation architecture.
* Trusted advisor on deal strategy, not only demos.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, NCR (New Delhi), with regular travel to government offices.

**Good to Have:**

* Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including Now Assist and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with MeitY empanelment, GeM, CERT-In, the DPDP Act, and the IndiaAI Mission.
* Existing government and SI network.

**What We Offer:**

* A structured AI upskilling path to expert level over 6-12 months.
* Direct access to regional AI experts for design, proof of concepts, and deal support.
* Ground-floor ownership of a new vertical in India.

TR21

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

**Our Why At Dotmatics**

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

**We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.**

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

**We are looking for** **people who** hold an advanced degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry and have a minimum of 3-5 years experience in a customer facing role. * Extensive knowledge of antibody drug development and molecular biology
* Personal use of AI-driven work practices
* Working Knowledge of Scientific/informatics software
* Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security
* SQL and Python in order to build prototypes of workflows and integrations to enable customer understanding the configuration extensions
* Experience with Dotmatics’ applications such as Snapgene, Geneious Prime and Biologics, and Prism
* Modeling scientific data, and crafting solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices
* Conduct & deliver needs analysis to understand scientific challenges, business needs, and critical requirements
* Working understanding of implementing, supporting, and/or integrating scientific systems

You may also demonstrate

* Additional language skills
* An understanding of the lifecycle of pharma, biopharma industries
* An understanding of Consumer Packaged Goods industry processes
* Written and oral communication & presentation skills for internal & external audiences

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

**Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.**
