5693740e.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Passionate about customer value creation, you will be adept at measuring and quantifying customer value realization and ensuring it stays on path. Successful candidates will have a technical program management background, technology foundation and consultative mindset, be detail driven, and have experience in managing teams to deliver complex programs. You will be a passionate and proven leader with the ability to gain stakeholder buy-in, communicate confidently at both the executive and project team level, and collaborate with a wide range of technical and non-technical teams, regardless of geographical or organizational boundaries to ensure compliance with AWS Standards, policies and best practices. You will be comfortable in working with diverse teams to ensure appropriate partners are on-boarded and involved in the migration as required. Be an active participant of steering committees and governance structures regardless of who is leading the migration and modernization and act as the point of contact for escalations if the migration and modernization hits barriers. You will be proactive in assessing Migration and modernization progress and design and implement plans to mitigate any risks or delays. Along with project management cadence, you will support the people and process pillars of migration including CCOE design and be the overall owner of reporting and system updates related to the health of migration. You will be a natural problem solver with a cool head that can deal with ambiguity, work autonomously to drive the deliver results for your customer, build IP, and share best practice across geographies.

**Function**

Cybersecurity

**Our Company**
===============

We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks – can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

**Job description**
===================

Job Summary:\*\*
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Security Program Manager to lead and manage various security initiatives and projects for HITACHI VANTARA LLC. This role involves developing, implementing, and overseeing security programs to protect our information assets, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and driving continuous improvement in our security posture.
  
  
Job Responsibilities:\*\*

* Manage the full lifecycle of security projects, including planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.
* Lead cross-functional teams to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across various systems, applications, and infrastructure.

* Develop and deliver security awareness training and education programs for employees across the organization.
* Manage security incident response plans, procedures, and exercises, ensuring effective and timely resolution of security incidents.
* Evaluate and recommend security technologies and solutions to enhance the organization's security capabilities.
* Prepare and present security reports, metrics, and program updates to senior management and stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging security threats, technologies, and industry trends to continuously improve our security posture.

  
Job Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in information security, with at least 3 years in a security program management role.
* Proven experience in managing complex security programs and projects, utilizing project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).

* Familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX).
* Certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM, CIPP/US, or equivalent are highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and ownership-driven leader who proactively identifies opportunities, challenges assumptions, and drives outcomes end-to-end. 589163ea.title: Senior Manager Technical Program Manager
589163ea.description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As a Staff Technical Program Manager at Teradata, you will drive delivery of significant, multi-team technical programs across Teradata's product portfolio, owning execution from kickoff through launch while building strong relationships with engineering, product, and business partners.

* Own planning, execution, and delivery tracking for complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and product areas.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone tracking dashboards.
* Facilitate cross-team coordination and decision-making to keep programs on track — running standups, program syncs, and steering reviews.
* Translate technical program status into crisp stakeholder updates for product leadership and senior engineering audiences.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks early; lead focused retrospectives to drive continuous process improvement.
* Coordinate launch readiness activities across engineering, QA, documentation, support, and go-to-market teams.
* Support data-driven prioritization by maintaining program metrics and surfacing trade-off analysis to product and engineering leadership.
* Apply foundational AI skills to explore and implement ways AI can enhance productivity, innovation, and impact across our workforce.

**WhoYou’ll Work With**

You will work as an embedded delivery partner within Teradata's Product organization, collaborating daily with:

* Product Managers and Principal TPMs to align delivery timelines with roadmap commitments.
* Engineering managers, tech leads, and QA teams across Vantage platform, cloud services, and analytics product areas.
* Design, Technical Writing, Support, and Marketing teams to coordinate end-to-end feature delivery and launch readiness.
* Finance and TA partners on program-level resourcing and onboarding coordination for growing engineering teams.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 6+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or data analytics.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-team delivery programs involving engineering teams of 20 or more.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data systems, or SaaS product delivery cycles.
* Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methodologies, sprint planning, and program-level tracking tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills — able to run effective meetings, surface issues clearly, and write crisp status reports.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

**What You'll Bring**

* Familiarity with data warehousing, SQL analytics, or cloud data infrastructure concepts.
* Experience coordinating programs that span US and international engineering teams (India experience a plus).
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar delivery management tools.
* Background in enterprise SaaS, B2B analytics, or open-source data ecosystem delivery preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep complex programs tidy and stakeholders informed.
* Ability to build trust quickly with engineers and product managers; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than a process overhead.
* A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. **An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.

* Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.

GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

role within the

Key Responsibilities

b3e2945c.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
b3e2945c.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Technical Program Manager
  
  
Mastercard Networks Exchange is an intelligent and scalable offering that enables transaction originators and receivers to link to different
  
  
networks in the end-to-end transaction flow with just a single connection.
  
  
This one connection to global and regional payment rails reduces the cost and complications of managing individual connections to
  
  
multiple networks. As a trusted connectivity partner, Mastercard Networks Exchange presents a unified approach to help customers achieve economics of scale.
  
  
NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise
  
  
Works with multiple scrum/delivery teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
  
  
Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level; coordinates with other TPMs in the program to align and plan potential actions to be implemented across the program
  
  
Looks across the program to identify potential system efficiencies or process improvements, and suggests proactive strategies for consideration by program leadership
  
  
Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
  
  
Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
  
  
Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
  
  
**All About You**
Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams, demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
  
  
Experience in building large scale enterprise technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery and experience articulating the impact using metrics.
  
  
Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
  
  
Help customers and the engineering teams make trade-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
  
  
Proven track record of data-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
  
  
Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
  
  
Expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, huge plus if you have expertise in CI/CD, SQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model are a plus
  
  
Technical program delivery experience
  
  
Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and ownership-driven leader who proactively identifies opportunities, challenges assumptions, and drives outcomes end-to-end. Demonstrates a builder's mindset, taking initiative to solve complex business and technical problems rather than operating as an order taker.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Drive best practices, knowledge sharing and scalable delivery models across teams and accounts.

Support effective resource allocation and workforce demand planning while maintaining delivery quality and client satisfaction.

Partner with leadership and Talent Acquisition teams to support strategic hiring and workforce planning requirements.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk and enhance overall delivery maturity.

12+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Project/Program Management, Client Delivery, Managed Services, Application Support Operations or related roles.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and escalation management capabilities.

Strong people and delivery leadership

Project and program management discipline

Senior stakeholder and client management

Ownership, accountability and results orientation

Strong communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills

Ability to work effectively across geographies and time zones

The individual should be comfortable participating in global meetings and supporting critical business requirements outside standard working hours when required.

f47f9579.title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
f47f9579.description:
**Req ID:** 395525
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
  
**Senior Solution Architecture Role | Primary Skill:** Finance | Secondary Skill: Controlling
  
Job Summary
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to serve as the senior subject matter expert and central solution authority for SAP Finance within NTT DATA. This role requires deep expertise in Financial Accounting, supported by strong working knowledge of Controlling, and will provide leadership across assessments, advisory engagements, implementations, conversions, and optimization programs.
  
The architect will work directly with CFOs, controllers, finance leaders, business process owners, enterprise architects, and SAP delivery teams. The individual will help clients understand finance processes and SAP capabilities, analyze complex requirements and pain points, answer solution questions, evaluate options, and define scalable SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions aligned with standard functionality and clean-core principles.
  
This is a client-facing and practice leadership role for a hands-on architect who can operate across business process advisory, solution design, delivery governance, presales support, and issue resolution. Manufacturing industry experience is required, together with experience in one or more additional industries.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
SAP Finance Solution Leadership
  

* Serve as the senior SAP Finance SME across SAP S/4HANA transformation, assessment, implementation, and advisory engagements.
* Own the Finance solution strategy and architecture across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Selective Data Transition programs.
* Lead end-to-end solution design for Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
* Provide architecture-level oversight for Controlling and management accounting, ensuring full integration with the Finance solution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex Finance design, integration, data, reporting, and delivery issues.
* Establish reusable Finance architecture principles, design standards, and leading practices across client engagements.

Finance Solution Design and Architecture
  

* Lead solution architecture and detailed design for core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities, including:

o General Ledger, Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, currencies, and document splitting
  
o Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner, and payment processing
  
o Asset Accounting, bank accounting, tax, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany accounting
  
o Financial close, statutory and management reporting, embedded analytics, and SAP Fiori for Finance
  
o Credit, collections, dispute management, cash management, and Treasury integration
  

* Translate business, accounting, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Evaluate solution alternatives, articulate trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to business and project leadership.
* Ensure alignment with SAP standard capabilities, S/4HANA simplifications, clean-core principles, and future-state enterprise architecture.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversion designs, and integration specifications.

Client Advisory and Finance Transformation
  

* Engage with CFOs, controllers, finance directors, process owners, and business users to understand current processes, business challenges, controls, and strategic priorities.
* Lead finance assessments, discovery sessions, Fit-to-Standard workshops, and future-state process design sessions.
* Help clients understand SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and explain complex solution concepts in clear business language.
* Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved reporting.
* Develop finance transformation roadmaps, solution options, implementation strategies, business cases, and executive recommendations.
* Advise on finance operating models, shared services, close optimization, governance, chart of accounts harmonization, and organizational design.

S/4HANA Transformation and Delivery
  

* Assess the impact of S/4HANA simplifications on finance processes, configuration, reports, interfaces, controls, and custom developments.
* Guide decisions related to ledger and currency strategy, parallel accounting, document splitting, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, and financial reporting.
* Lead or advise on Finance data migration for balances, open items, assets, bank and tax data, cost objects, and historical data.
* Assess RICEFW requirements and challenge unnecessary customization to support a clean-core solution.
* Provide solution oversight through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Support test strategy, defect resolution, mock conversions, financial reconciliation, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

Integration and Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Coordinate closely with MM, SD, PP, QM, EWM, PM, PS, HCM, Treasury, Group Reporting, planning, data, security, and technical teams.
* Ensure accurate and complete financial integration across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Project-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, and Record-to-Report.
* Provide Finance leadership for account determination, valuation, settlement, allocations, intercompany processing, and reporting across integrated business processes.
* Collaborate with ABAP, integration, data, analytics, workflow, and Fiori teams on enhancements and interfaces.
* Ensure the Finance solution aligns with the broader SAP and non-SAP landscape and enterprise architecture.

Controlling and Manufacturing Finance Support
  

* Provide architecture-level guidance for Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ensure Controlling design is integrated with Financial Accounting and aligned with business reporting and performance management needs.
* Support manufacturing finance requirements such as inventory valuation, standard and actual costing, production variances, production order settlement, and profitability reporting.
* Partner with specialized Controlling consultants for detailed configuration or complex industry-specific scenarios.

Practice and Team Leadership
  

* Act as the central SAP Finance solution authority and trusted advisor within NTT DATA.
* Support client assessments, pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
* Mentor Finance consultants, workstream leads, and architects and provide guidance on complex design and integration topics.
* Develop reusable assessment frameworks, solution standards, design principles, and leading-practice content.
* Work effectively within global onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models and manage multiple priorities across concurrent engagements.

Required Skills and Experience
  
**Primary Skill:** SAP Financial Accounting
  

* 20+ years of SAP experience with deep functional, advisory, and solution architecture expertise in SAP Finance.
* Strong hands-on and architecture experience in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, parallel ledgers and currencies, document splitting, tax, statutory reporting, and financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Finance architecture, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, financial close, and SAP Fiori.
* At least 3-5 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA transformation or implementation programs in a Finance Solution Architect, Finance Lead, or equivalent senior role.
* Experience designing Finance solutions across multiple legal entities, currencies, countries, and accounting standards.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, compliance, statutory requirements, and management reporting.

**Secondary Skill:** SAP Controlling
  

* Strong working knowledge of SAP Controlling and its integration with Financial Accounting.
* Experience with Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ability to provide architecture-level guidance for Controlling while partnering with specialized CO consultants for detailed design and configuration.
* Understanding of manufacturing cost flows, inventory valuation, production variances, actual costing, settlement, and profitability reporting.

Finance Transformation and Industry Knowledge
  

* Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, financial close, reporting, compliance, internal controls, and process governance.
* Significant industry experience in manufacturing, including discrete and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Experience in one or more industries such as Life Sciences, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Products, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, or High Technology.
* Experience supporting global organizations with multiple legal entities, currencies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
* Ability to understand industry-specific finance requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.

Architecture, Advisory, and Leadership Skills
  

* Proven ability to assess complex finance requirements and develop practical, scalable solution recommendations.
* Experience leading assessments, Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization, and future-state solution design.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences.
* Strong understanding of Finance integration, data migration, reporting, security, controls, and custom development considerations.
* Proven experience leading SAP Finance teams in large, complex transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive presence, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification and experience with SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience with SAP Central Finance is highly desirable.
* Experience to Group Reporting, Advanced Financial Closing, SAP Analytics Cloud, Treasury, FSCM, or Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Experience with RISE with SAP, SAP Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM, and clean-core governance.
* Experience supporting presales, solution architecture reviews, assessments, proposals, and estimates.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent is an advantage.

Soft Skills
  

* Strong analytical, advisory, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to effectively engage with CxOs
* Ability to translate complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Confidence working with senior finance leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic architect and a hands-on solution advisor.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and client-service mindset.

Location and Work Model
  

* Location:
* Work model: Hybrid, onsite
* Travel may be required based on client and delivery needs.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. 858a1a5d.description:

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
As a member of our Solution Consulting team, you will have a major impact on our future success by supporting [Employee Experience, Customer Workflow, ITX] Solution Sales. You will guide revenue for one of our products with the support and partnership of Sales, Product Management, and the executive team. b7f2fd7d.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
b7f2fd7d.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting-edge proof-of-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
  
  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection & Response), Endpoint Security and Real-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre & Campus network solutions using leaf-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert-level knowledge of industry-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

29f2fe75.title: Solutions Engineer (Bangalore)
29f2fe75.description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Our Technical Sales team partners closely with customers, partners, and account teams to deliver innovative Cisco solutions that address business and technology needs. As trusted technical advisors, we bring together Cisco’s portfolio, technical expertise, and customer insights to drive business outcomes, expand customer relationships, and accelerate growth.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Technical Sales Professional, you will own the technical relationship with customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and Cisco brand ambassador. You will work closely with account teams and cross-functional sales teams to understand customer business priorities, translate them into technical requirements, and design and present relevant Cisco solutions.
  
  
You will play a key role throughout the technical sales process—from identifying and landing opportunities to expanding Cisco’s footprint within existing accounts—while helping customers achieve their desired business outcomes.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Develop and refine technical sales approaches aligned to clearly defined customer and partner requirements.
* Build strong knowledge of Cisco's portfolio and progressively develop specialization within a technical domain.
* Own technical relationships with customers and partners, engaging with IT teams, business stakeholders, decision-makers, and implementers.
* Analyze customer environments, business requirements, market trends, and competitive positioning to identify and shape opportunities.
* Translate customer and partner business needs into technical requirements and recommend appropriate Cisco solutions.
* Contribute to customer account planning, solution design, demand generation, and enablement activities.
* Identify opportunities to expand Cisco's portfolio across areas such as networking, security, observability, and collaboration.
* Lead technical engagements, presentations, demonstrations, and solution discussions tailored to specific customer scenarios.
* Use market trends and competitive insights to effectively position Cisco solutions and support competitive displacement.
* Collaborate with account teams, business entities, sales teams, partners, and other internal resources to drive customer success.
* Manage and coordinate virtual technical support resources throughout the sales cycle.
* Provide feedback to business entities and relevant sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive trends.
* Share best practices and contribute to the development of technical and educational materials.
* Adapt workflows and approaches to effectively respond to changing customer and business requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 3+ years of related experience.
* Experience in a technical sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales, or related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience understanding customer business and technical requirements and translating them into technology solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, or solution discussions to customers or partners.
* Experience working collaboratively with sales, technical, and cross-functional teams throughout a sales cycle.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise technology solutions and experience developing expertise within a technical domain.
* Experience with Cisco technologies and/or enterprise networking, security, observability, or collaboration solutions.
* Understanding of competitive technology landscapes and experience positioning solutions against competitors.
* Strong customer engagement, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to navigate complex customer organizations and build relationships with technical and business decision-makers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

e80f6059.description:
**Role Summary**

A senior technical leader responsible for the overall Digital Workplace architecture strategy across one or more large client accounts. Owns solution design, transformation roadmaps, governance, and technical leadership across device management, virtual workspace, application/image management, and collaboration platforms. Serves as the primary technical point of contact for client CTO/IT leadership on Digital Workplace modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Digital Workplace architecture strategy and modernization roadmap (cloud-first, Zero Trust, Modern Management adoption).
* Lead large-scale transformation programs: legacy-to-cloud migrations (SCCM to Intune, on-prem Exchange to Exchange Online, physical desktop to VDI/Cloud PC).
* Provide architectural governance review and approve HLD/LLD across multiple workstreams and delivery pods.
* Act as trusted advisor to client stakeholders; participate in steering committee discussions and technology roadmap planning.
* Lead solutioning for large deals/RFPs — architecture, staffing pyramid, commercial inputs, and win strategy alongside pre-sales.
* Own vendor and OEM relationship management (Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, Ivanti, etc.) for licensing, roadmap alignment, and escalations.
* Establish and enforce security, compliance, and governance frameworks across the Digital Workplace estate.
* Drive innovation — AI-enabled IT support (Copilot, virtual agents), automation, self-healing endpoints, experience analytics (Nexthink, DEX tools).
* Own P&L/delivery metrics (SLA/KPI, CSAT) for the Digital Workplace tower within the account.
* Build and mentor a multi-level team of architects, leads, and engineers (30–100+ FTEs typically).

**Required Skillset**

**WirelessCar’s Journey**

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

As a Solution Architect with 15+ years of experience, you will help shape and evolve the architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle — from business needs and early design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution. You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions.
  
  
Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions.
  
  
**Your Impact**:
  

* Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services.
* Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs.
* Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost.
* Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.
* Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects.

  
**What We're Looking For**  

* You are a technically experienced and pragmatic person who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.
* You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping a team reach a good solution.
* You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams — not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

  
**We believe you bring:**  

* Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure.
* A strong background in software engineering and modern agile development practices.
* Experience designing distributed systems and working with areas such as APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures.
* An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost.
* Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions.
* Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences.
* Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments. It would be a plus if you have
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms or similar cloud-native technologies.
* Experience with system or data migration initiatives.
* Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities.
* Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures.
* Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements.
* Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation.
* Experience working with globally distributed development teams.
* Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions.
* Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications.

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

27b0f7d7.title: AES - DE - Generative AI Solution Architect
27b0f7d7.description:
**Engineering Foundation**
==========================

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**
==================

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**
---------------------------------

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**
-----------------------

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**
====================================

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**
=============================

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**
=====================

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

**What We Are Not Looking For**
===============================

* Someone who lists LLMs on a resume but has only called the API in a notebook
* People who explain everything in terms of frameworks they have never deployed
* Consultants who can only narrate what others have built
* Engineers who cannot hold a client conversation, and client-facing people who cannot build

**How We Will Evaluate You**
============================

**Stage 0, System design with no AI.** A distributed systems problem with no LLM in it. Event flow, data model, failure handling, scale. Twenty-five minutes.

**Stage 1, Technical screen.** Walk us through a system you built. Bring an artifact: an eval set, a trace from a run that failed, a postmortem, a cost-per-task number. Something real, not slides.

**Stage 2, Architecture discussion.** A business problem, live. Design the solution and defend the trade-offs, including the decision not to use agents.

**Stage 3, Client simulation.** Present your approach to a non-technical executive audience, then advise them on how to build the capability internally.

**Not a theory round.** Expect to walk through something you have actually built: the architecture decisions, what broke in production, what you would do differently. If you cannot do that with specifics, this role is not the right fit.

* Solid experience in solution and enterprise architecture across application, data, integration and security domains, with a track record of leading implementations from design to go-live.
* Strong knowledge of integration architecture and patterns, including REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, event-driven and file-based interfaces, middleware and API management.
* Strong knowledge of architecture for security, high availability, disaster recovery and performance, including database design and Windows Server/Linux environments.

* Good to have: OpenText Content Server (OTCS) and Extended ECM, including the Extended ECM for SAP SuccessFactors integration, Archive Center, OTDS and Records Management.
* Good to have: knowledge of the wider HR systems landscape, including SAP HCM, payroll, time management and identity/access integration.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline. Architecture certifications (e.g. TOGAF) are a plus; SAP SuccessFactors and OpenText certifications are nice-to-have.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, mentor others and interact with stakeholders at all levels.
* Exposure to AI tools, even at a basic level, is a value-add.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  
**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end-to-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real-time visibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Design the target-state architecture for global planning, defining the co-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End-to-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm & Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive-level decision-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.

Domain Expertise & Planning Principles
  
  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply & Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response & Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re-balancing during disruptions.

Technical Proficiency
  
  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply & Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.

04c26928.title: Enterprise Architect
04c26928.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**Why Join Us**

* A unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a newly formed global healthcare innovator.
* High visibility to senior executives.
* Modernization initiatives underway (SAP S/4, cloud migration, data platform modernization, AI transformation).
* Ability to influence enterprise operating models and standards across a global organization.
Chance to mature an EA practice from the ground up.  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

The IT Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor role in the Global IT organization, based in India, with significant enterprise influence and visibility. This role serves as a visible change agent that drives business and technology innovation and alignment across Solventum’s global enterprise. The role is expected to operate as a strategic leader within the federated Enterprise Architecture team, drive technology asset management as a strategic imperative, own ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes and tooling, and help deliver a unified 3-year enterprise technology roadmap that reduces duplication, increases organizational transparency and agility, and accelerates business growth and transformation. Over time, this role may expand into formal people leadership as the Enterprise Architecture capability matures in India.

This role facilitates EA team activities including defining, documenting, and governing the enterprise IT architecture. The Enterprise Architect leads architecture consulting efforts to investigate and align technology solutions with business strategies, evaluates new and emerging technologies, creates architectural blueprints and target-state definitions, and assures technology solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture direction. The Architect also leads through influence in Architecture Review Board activities that shape technology innovation, govern technology adoption globally, and drive consistent architecture definition across technology domains.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* **Architecture Governance:** Coordinate, create, publish, and measure adoption of architectural artifacts, including standards, policies, principles, reference architectures, and target-state definitions across technology domains and technology asset classes.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Facilitate Architecture Review Board activities ensuring responsive processes, rightsizing architecture reviews, and strengthening engagement of technical teams, business leaders, and program/project managers.

* **Technology Asset Management Leadership:** Lead technology asset management as a strategic imperative by establishing governance, lifecycle standards, CMDB data quality, ownership models, and decision processes that improve visibility, reduce risk, and enable rationalization across Solventum’s technology portfolio.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management Ownership:** Own and continuously improve ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes, data standards, workflows, reporting, and tooling adoption to ensure accurate application inventory, business capability alignment, lifecycle status, technology risk visibility, and actionable portfolio insights.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Technology Architecture Definition:** Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures for enterprise technology assets including applications, data and integrations, infrastructure, security systems, and shared platforms. Establish architecture patterns, principles, and roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy and create an integrated, scalable technology landscape.
* undefined
* **Technology Lifecycle Management:** Conduct research, assess and evangelize new technologies where appropriate, and drive lifecycle management for implemented technologies. Partner with business, product, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to guide modernization, standardization, consolidation, retirement, and investment decisions.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Delivery Leadership:** Lead architecture delivery through influence by coordinating architects, platform teams, and cross-functional stakeholders in the creation and publication of detailed architectural artifacts and technical solutions. As the capability matures, this role may expand to include formal people leadership responsibilities for architects or architecture delivery teams.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher AND ten (10) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

OR

* High School Diploma/GED AND fourteen (14) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following skills and experiences are also required:

* Enterprise Architecture experience, which includes business, application, data, technology, and security architecture domains, with demonstrated ability to define architecture direction and translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.
