3760fd00.title: Technical Delivery Manager
3760fd00.description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.
  
  
**ROLE PROFILE:**
A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.
* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.
* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.
* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.
* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

**Why Join Us?**
This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
  
  
Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.
  
  
If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

a4207bbe.title: Associate (AI) Solution Consultant
a4207bbe.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**Role Description**
As an Associate Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
  
  
**Launch Your Enterprise Software Career**
Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.
  
  
Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.
  
  
During the program, you will be joining the Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.
  
  
This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.
  
  
Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:
  
  

* Discovery & AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

**What You'll Do:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
* Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
* Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
* Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
* Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

**What You Need:**

* Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
* Excellent academic performance
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
* Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
* Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
* Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

**Bonus Points:**

* Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
* Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
* Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
* Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

This a full time, unlimited position in our Bangalore office.
  
  
**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

3737851f.title: Sr Solutions Consultant I
3737851f.description:
**Who We Are**
Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. * Deep understanding of the interdependencies between Operations, Technology, and corporate functions such as Finance, Compliance, and Tax.

* Demonstrated success managing or mentoring less experienced consultants.
* Advanced knowledge of process mapping, solution estimation, or proposal development.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**
We’re looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

83bdddba.title: Solution Architect – Python with GenAI
83bdddba.description:
Our expanding team is on the lookout for a Solution Architect focused on Python and Generative AI, responsible for engineering and delivering enterprise-caliber GenAI solutions built to perform in live production settings. As a member of our Solution Architecture team, you'll direct technical research initiatives, produce reusable tools, and help define standards for applications built around LLMs. Send in your application now to be part of pioneering GenAI work and support clients in reaching game-changing results.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Design full-scale GenAI architecture solutions, including RAG models, Agents, and Multi-Agent frameworks, built for large-scale enterprise use
* Produce reusable accelerator components and reference architectures to bring uniformity to solution delivery
* Lead technical discovery sessions and deliver direct, practical support to engineering teams
* Build evaluation frameworks and define standards that shape how LLM applications are developed
* Collaborate with a range of teams to ensure architectural designs scale appropriately and remain sustainable long-term
* Develop microservices-based systems by applying established patterns and current-generation frameworks
* Guide the integration of cloud infrastructure elements across environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP

3d31e86e.title: DE - Cloud - Senior Data Platform Engineer - GDSN02
3d31e86e.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Data Platform Engineer**
**The opportunity**
Your role will be a Technology Lead, or Senior Technology Lead in the Cloud Engineering team. You will be responsible to be a part of the delivery of IT projects for our customers across the globe.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and manage Databricks/Snowflake infrastructure on Azure and AWS, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-effective deployments.

* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for Databricks workloads using native and third-party tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Optimize Databricks cluster performance and cost, including autoscaling, spot instance usage, and job scheduling.
* Ensure security best practices: manage secrets, network isolation, encryption, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and ML teams to enable seamless integration and workflow automation.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices: integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DataOps/MLOps pipelines.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for Databricks platform issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Document architecture, processes, and best practices for knowledge sharing and operational excellence.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expertise in Databricks/Snowflake administration, including workspace, cluster, and job management.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), including networking, IAM, and cost management.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and source control (Git).
* Deep understanding of DataOps and MLOps concepts, including orchestration, versioning, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with data governance tools and frameworks (Unity Catalog, Purview, AWS Lake Formation, etc.).
* Ability to design secure, compliant, and scalable data architectures in multi-cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills for distributed data and ML workloads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive platform adoption.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security tools into data pipelines.
* Ability to mentor and upskill teams on Databricks, DataOps, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Experience with regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in cloud data environments is a plus.
* Capability to identify software packages and solutions that could meet client solution requirements and develop requests for proposal (RFP’s) from these vendors. Assist clients in the evaluation of the resulting proposals, including the package capabilities and fit to the requirements (business and technology), vendor proposals for pricing and support.
* Capability to design and developed AI infused DevOps and Platform Engineering framework.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/B.Tech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4 to 8 years
* Cloud Computing knowledge in multi cloud environments (Azure, AWS)
* Hands-on experience with Databricks administration on Azure and/or AWS, including workspace, cluster, and job management
* DevOps – Setting up CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI
* Strong understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, including orchestration, monitoring, and governance
* Hands-on experience with containerization, including Docker & Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE)
* Scripting Knowledge on PowerShell, python, Groovy, Shell Scripting and cloud native CLIs
* Must be good in IAC tools such as Terraform or ARM or Bicep
* Must be good in Config Management Tools such as Ansible or Chef or Puppet
* Expertise in Golden Paths creation for end-to-end developer workflows.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions (AZ-305)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* Hashicorp Certified: Terraform Associates
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* GitHub Actions
* Github Copilot
* Good to have knowledge in Terraform Cloud, Ansible Tower

**Your People Responsibilities**

* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives
* Ability to travel in accordance with client and other job requirements
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; writing, publishing, and conference-level presentation skills a plus

**Technologies and Tools**

* Cloud platform – Azure, AWS
* SDLC Methodologies: Agile /Scrum
* Version Control Tools – GitHub/ Bitbucket/GitLab
* CI/CD Automation Tools – Azure DevOps/ Bamboo/ Team City/ Harness/ Octopus
* Container Management Tools – Docker/Kubernetes/Docker Swarm
* Application Performance Management Tools – Prometheus/ Dynatrace/ AppDynamics
* Monitoring Tools – Splunk/ Datadog/ Grafana
* IAC Tools – Terraform/ARM Templates/ Bicep
* Config Management Tools – Chef/ puppet/ Ansible
* Test Automation Tools – Selenium/Cucumber
* Artifact Management Tools – Jfrog Artifactory/Nexus/CloudRepo/Azure Artifactory
* Scripting - Python/Groovy/PowerShell/Shell Scripting
* SAST/ DAST: SonarQube / Veracode/ Fortify
* GitOps Tool – Argo CD/ Flux CD
* GenAI Technology – Chat GPT, OpenAI

**What We Look For**

* Has successfully demonstrated CI/CD Automation skills and technologies during many relevant projects
* Strong experience in the use of DevOps Tools and technologies, including container technologies.
* Proven experience in Infrastructure Automation (IAC Tools + Config Mgmt. Tool) and experience in Application Automation using Azure DevOps
* Working experience in Azure and strong knowledge in cloud Architecture strategy.
* Good Exposure in Cloud and Container Monitoring and logging and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Cloud related concepts and technologies, and maintains an in-depth knowledge of the area
* Experience designing and conducting research and experiments with recently developed technologies

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
* Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
* Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
* Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
* Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
* Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
* Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
* Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
* Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
* Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
* Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
* Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
* Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
* Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.
* Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
* Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

**Position:**
Technical Customer Success Manager – SaaS Integrations
  
  
**Experience:**
4–7 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai (Work from Office)
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department:**
Integrations / Customer Success
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Customer Success Manager with 4+ years of experience in SaaS integrations, technical project management, API integrations, and customer-facing technical operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess a strong technical understanding of SaaS platforms, REST APIs, integration workflows, and automation technologies, along with excellent customer communication and project management skills.
  
  
This role will primarily focus on
**post-implementation customer success**
, ensuring seamless transitions from project delivery to ongoing operational support, maintaining integration stability, resolving technical challenges, and driving continuous improvements.
  
  
The candidate will act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers after their integration projects go live, collaborating with engineering, implementation, and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* SaaS Integration Management
* Understand and manage integrations between SaaS applications and third-party platforms.
* Troubleshoot API failures, authentication issues, data synchronization errors, and integration disruptions.
* Analyze integration workflows, field mappings, data transformations, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Support integrations built using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and integration automation platforms.
* Identify integration performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Ensure integrations continue functioning reliably when SaaS platforms or APIs change.
* Technical Project Management
* Independently manage multiple customer integration accounts and post-go-live activities.
* Plan and coordinate bug fixes, enhancements, integration changes, and technical improvements.
* Track customer requests, issues, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively.
* Coordinate with developers, QA engineers, and Technical Leads for issue resolution.
* Provide clear and timely status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to internal delivery processes.
* Post-Go-Live Customer Success
* Take ownership of integration projects after successful production deployment.
* Manage the transition from implementation teams to customer success operations.
* Ensure integration stability, reliability, and successful ongoing operations.
* Conduct periodic customer check-ins and technical health reviews.
* Proactively identify integration risks, failures, and customer concerns.
* Maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and technical guidance.
* Drive issue resolution and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Incident Management & Technical Support
* Take ownership of customer-reported integration incidents.
* Perform initial technical investigation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident resolution with the appropriate technical teams.
* Manage issue severity, priority, escalation, and communication.
* Ensure critical customer issues receive appropriate attention.
* Document incident findings, resolutions, and preventive actions.
* Work toward reducing recurring production issues.
* Integration Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
* Monitor integration health, API failures, scheduled jobs, and data synchronization processes.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation.
* Recommend improvements to integration architecture and operational workflows.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and integration upgrades.
* Improve monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and support processes.

3904d550.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
3904d550.description:
NVIDIA's Connectivity Software team seeks a skilled and experienced technical program manager to help deliver on NVIDIA's inspiring product roadmap! The software produced by this team include foundational kernel components, drivers, and firmware that support the entire family of NVIDIA chipsets. Join an excellent team and help guide NVIDIA's future!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
You will collaborate with the team and peers across the company to build, represent and carry out detailed plans for delivering the team's work. In particular, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Work on aligning NVIDIA's SoC and product roadmap with the software team capacity roadmap and help balance global priorities
* Keep the team on track by coordinating dependencies across functional areas and identifying planning gaps
* Be empowered to make prioritization decisions and represent the team to other groups
* Collaborate closely with hardware, release planning, customers, and industry partners giving you a complete picture of software at NVIDIA
* Propose and develop new methods to handle projects and unify planning systems
* Define and track metrics to improve execution efficiency
* Manage technical and program-level interactions with external partners and vendors, ensuring alignment on requirements, dependencies, schedules, and deliverables.

**What We Need To See**

* 8+ overall years of program management experience in delivering software products.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or similar field or equivalent experience
* Proven track record of balancing short-term delivery towards critical timelines alongside thoughtful long-term steps towards improving planning, processes, and team capabilities.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Knowledge of SOC, IO peripherals or CPU project management
* Past experience as a software developer
* Background in Networking protocols, PCIe, USB, machine learning, or accelerated computing
* Experience with software productivity tools and process automation

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

dee94a3f.title: Security Program Manager
dee94a3f.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Program Manager based in India.**
We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity professional to lead strategic security programs and initiatives that protect critical information assets and strengthen organizational resilience. In this role, you will oversee the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of security projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with IT, engineering, and business teams to identify risks, implement effective controls, and integrate security into operational processes and the software development lifecycle. Your responsibilities will span vulnerability management, incident response, security audits, compliance, and employee awareness. Through data-driven reporting and stakeholder engagement, you will communicate program progress, highlight emerging risks, and drive informed decision-making. This remote opportunity offers the chance to influence enterprise security strategy while working with diverse teams in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and implement comprehensive security programs, strategies, and roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives, recognized security frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Manage the complete lifecycle of security projects, including planning, resource coordination, execution, monitoring, risk management, and reporting, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Lead cross-functional teams in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and mitigating security risks across systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure.
* Establish, maintain, and improve security policies, standards, procedures, and controls in alignment with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GDPR.
* Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security audit activities, coordinating remediation efforts and tracking progress through to resolution.
* Collaborate with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to embed security requirements into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and broader operational processes.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and education programs that promote secure practices and strengthen employee understanding of cybersecurity responsibilities.
* Maintain and improve security incident response plans, procedures, and exercises to support effective detection, response, recovery, and incident resolution.
* Evaluate emerging security technologies and solutions, recommending improvements that enhance organizational security capabilities and operational effectiveness.
* Prepare and present security metrics, program updates, risk assessments, and performance reports to senior management and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging cyber threats, security technologies, regulatory changes, and industry developments to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Coordinate program priorities and manage dependencies across multiple initiatives while maintaining clear communication, accountability, and alignment with business goals.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
* At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in information security, including a minimum of 3 years in security program management.
* Proven experience managing complex cybersecurity programs and projects using established project management methodologies, such as Agile or Waterfall.
* Strong understanding of information security principles, governance frameworks, controls, and industry best practices, including NIST, ISO 27001, and COBIT.
* Broad technical knowledge across application security, network security, cloud security, data protection, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and SOX.
* Experience overseeing security risk assessments, vulnerability remediation, penetration testing, security audits, and incident response initiatives.
* Relevant professional certifications, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States (CIPP/US), or equivalent credentials, are highly desirable.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and sound judgment when assessing risks and prioritizing security initiatives.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and competing priorities, and adapt to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and reporting skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, program performance, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

**Benefits**

* Employment type: Full-time position.
* Location: Remote, India.
* Flexible working arrangements: Flexible work options designed to support work-life balance, subject to role and location requirements.
* Health and well-being: Access to benefits, support, and services intended to promote overall employee health and well-being.
* Professional development: Opportunities to expand cybersecurity expertise and contribute to enterprise-wide security initiatives.
* Meaningful impact: Opportunity to influence security strategy, improve organizational resilience, and strengthen risk management practices.
* Collaborative environment: Work alongside global teams and professionals across technology, engineering, and business functions.
* Autonomy and ownership: Scope to lead programs, drive improvements, and contribute to strategic decisions.
* Inclusive culture: A workplace that values diversity, mutual respect, equal opportunity, and merit-based development.

95e209f5.title: Program Manager ( FM/MM)
95e209f5.description:
**Program Manager - First Mile / Middle Mile**
**About Blitz**
Blitz enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability & unlock the growth of new-age eCommerce brands by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable & affordable. Same-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% - 40% increase in their website conversions & increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Program Manager to drive initiatives across our first-mile and mid-mile network, covering the movement of goods from vendors to mother hubs and warehouses, and onward to dark stores. You will own programs that improve speed, cost, reliability, and scalability of inbound and line-haul operations, so that stores stay replenished on time in a high-velocity business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Plan and run first-mile and mid-mile programs end to end, from scoping and milestones to delivery and post-launch review.
* Maintain roadmaps, risk logs, and dependency trackers across Procurement, Warehousing, Transport, Finance, Tech, and Store Operations.
* Run weekly and monthly business reviews and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

**First Mile Programs**

* Drive vendor pickup and inbound scheduling programs, including appointment booking, slot management, and dock-to-stock TAT improvement.
* Improve farm-to-hub and vendor-to-warehouse flows for fresh and perishable categories, with a focus on quality, wastage, and cold chain.
* Work with procurement on vendor delivery compliance, ASN accuracy, and inbound OTIF.

**Mid Mile Programs**

* Optimize line-haul and hub-to-dark-store movement through route planning, trip consolidation, and fleet utilization.
* Run transporter onboarding, rate contracts, and performance management programs (vehicle fill, TAT, damage, delivery adherence).
* Improve replenishment cycle times and cut-off adherence so stores receive stock before peak demand windows.

**Cost & Network Optimization**

* Reduce cost per kg / cost per case / cost per trip through route optimization, load planning, and vendor mix changes.
* Support network design decisions such as hub placement, cross-docking, and milk-run models.
* Build business cases and size savings for new initiatives.

**Process, Tech & Automation**

* Define requirements and work with product and tech teams on TMS, route optimization, vehicle tracking (GPS/telematics), and inbound/outbound visibility tools.
* Standardize SOPs for loading, unloading, seal and handover, GRN, and shortage/damage claims.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time through process redesign and automation.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and track KPIs: inbound TAT, trip utilization, cost per trip, on-time dispatch and delivery, shortage and damage rates.
* Use data to find bottlenecks, run root-cause analyses, and drive corrective actions.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to transport, safety, and statutory requirements (E-way bill, vehicle documentation, driver compliance, FSSAI for food movement).
* Manage transporter SLAs, penalties, claims, and dispute resolution.

**Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transport operations, or program management, ideally in e-commerce, quick commerce, retail, FMCG, or 3PL.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent from a reputed institute preferred.
* Proven record of delivering cross-functional programs with measurable cost, speed, or reliability impact.

Sapiogen AI is an
**AI-first software engineering company**
helping startups, scale-ups, and enterprises build intelligent software products, modernize legacy systems, automate operations, and accelerate digital transformation.

We combine
**AI + human engineering expertise**
to deliver high-impact solutions across AI/ML, Generative AI, cloud, data, automation, digital engineering, and modern application development.

Our goal is simple:
**AI + Humans. Engineering 10x Faster.**

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Pre-Sales Solution Architect**
who can bridge the gap between
**business requirements, sales opportunities, and technical execution**
.

You will work closely with prospects, business decision-makers, sales teams, and engineering teams to understand client challenges, identify opportunities, design technical solutions, and convert complex requirements into compelling proposals and solution architectures.

  **business value and ROI**
  of proposed solutions.

* Evaluate AI feasibility, technical complexity, data requirements, security considerations, and expected ROI.

5. Proposal & Documentation

Create and maintain:

* Solution architecture documents
* Technical proposals
* Architecture diagrams
* RFP/RFI responses
* Statements of Work
* Technical estimations
* Project roadmaps
* Proof-of-Concept proposals
* Technology recommendations
* Implementation plans
* Cost and effort estimates
* Technical presentations and demos

* Participate in solution reviews and technical feasibility assessments.
* Ensure proposed solutions can realistically be delivered within the agreed scope, budget, and timeline.
* Act as the technical bridge between
  **client → sales → architecture → engineering**
  .

7. Client Presentations & Workshops

* Conduct technical presentations for CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, product leaders, and engineering teams.
* Lead architecture workshops and technical discovery sessions.
* Explain complex technical concepts in simple business language.
* Demonstrate prototypes, POCs, AI solutions, and proposed architectures when required.
* Build credibility and trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Technical Skills

Strong understanding of several of the following areas:

* AI / Generative AI
* LLMs and AI agents
* RAG architectures
* Python / JavaScript / TypeScript or similar programming languages
* REST APIs and system integrations
* Microservices
* Cloud architecture
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Data engineering
* DevOps & CI/CD
* Docker / Kubernetes
* SaaS architecture
* Web application architecture
* Enterprise application architecture
* Cybersecurity fundamentals
* API gateways and integration architecture

Hands-on development experience is strongly preferred.

Pre-Sales Skills

The candidate should be comfortable with:

* Client discovery
* Requirement gathering
* Technical qualification
* Solution design
* Estimation
* Proposal creation
* RFP/RFI responses
* Technical presentations
* POC planning
* Architecture diagrams
* SOW preparation
* Commercial discussions
* Technical objection handling
* Sales enablement

What We Are Looking For

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate with both
  **business and technical stakeholders**
  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Commercial understanding of software engineering engagements.
* Ability to understand business problems and convert them into technology solutions.
* Strong understanding of modern AI and software engineering.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-growing startup environment.
* Entrepreneurial mindset and ownership mentality.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Willingness to participate in client calls across international time zones when required.

Qualification

* 3–7 years of experience in
  **Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Pre-Sales, Software Engineering, or Technology Consulting**
  .
* Experience working with international clients is preferred.
* Experience in an IT services, software product, digital engineering, AI, or technology consulting company is preferred.

Preferred Experience

**Simform, Apexon, Ascendion, Persistent, Thoughtworks, Globant, EPAM, or other technology consulting/software engineering organizations**
will be preferred.

Experience in selling or architecting
**AI, cloud, data, digital engineering, automation, or enterprise software solutions**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number and value of opportunities supported

* Solution quality and feasibility
* Proposal turnaround time
* Client satisfaction during pre-sales
* Number of successful POCs

Career Growth

Based on performance, the candidate can progress toward:

**Senior Solution Architect → Lead Solution Architect → Principal Solution Architect → Head of Solutions / Pre-Sales → VP – Solutions / CTO-track leadership**

Why Join Sapiogen AI?

  **AI-first software engineering**

* Opportunity to shape solutions from the
  **first client conversation to production deployment**
  .
* High ownership and decision-making responsibility.
* Opportunity to grow into a senior technology and business leadership role.
* Build solutions across
  **AI, cloud, data, automation, and modern software engineering**
  .

Our Philosophy

**AI + Humans. Engineering 10x Faster.**

At Sapiogen AI, you won't simply be selling technology.

**You'll be designing the technology solutions that help businesses build what comes next.**

Presales Solution Architect, Quality Engineering (AI and GenAI)

Digital Engineering (DE-QE) | Hyderabad, India | Work from office

OSI Digital is seeking an experienced Presales Solution Consultant for its Quality Engineering practice. This person owns presales for QE and drives QE accelerators as a product line: turning customer testing problems into scoped, defensible solutions and commercial proposals, and building reusable QE assets that OSI can sell repeatedly.

The role is customer facing and solution led, not a pure delivery seat. It suits someone with real QE delivery depth, strong research instincts, and genuine hands-on AI and GenAI ability, who wants to shape and sell solutions while staying technically credible.

Key Responsibilities

* Own presales for the QE practice: qualify opportunities, run discovery calls, and scope QE solutions covering test strategy, test automation, performance, and security testing.

* Build effort estimates, proposals, solution decks, and responses to RFP and RFI documents, and defend the assumptions with customer stakeholders.

* Prepare and run tailored demos and proofs of concept, including AI assisted testing demos.

* Position and sell OSI accelerators into QE opportunities, showing where each reduces testing effort, cost, or risk.

* Identify, design, and drive net-new QE accelerators: reusable automation frameworks, AI assisted testing assets, and repeatable solution packages the practice can sell more than once.

* Own the go-to-market for QE accelerators: the pitch narrative, the demo, the reference architecture, and the packaging story.

* Design and demonstrate Gen AI assisted testing workflows: test case generation from requirements, test data synthesis, and automated test script drafting.

* Evaluate and honestly position AI features in testing tools, for example self-healing locators, visual validation, and risk-based test selection.

* Prototype LLM and retrieval-based aids for QE, such as a knowledge assistant over test documentation or GenAI support for defect triage.

* Research the QE tooling and vendor landscape and each prospect before engagement, and separate real capability from vendor marketing.

* Bridge the sold solution and the delivery team and contribute hands-on to early delivery on strategic accounts, so the approach is proven in practice.

* Support architecture and code reviews for QE automation and drive AI, GenAI adoption across the QE team.

* Produce solution documentation, reusable assets, and enablement material.

Required Skills and Experience

Core Experience

* 5 to 9 years of overall QA and QE experience, with at least 5 years hands-on in test automation.

* 2 or more years of practical, hands-on use of LLMs or GenAI in real work, not just awareness.

* Prior presales, solution consulting, or strong customer facing delivery exposure.

QE and Automation Skills

* Strong with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and RestAssured.

* API and UI automation, regression, and in-sprint testing.

* Test integration in CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows.

* Performance testing (JMeter, k6, or NeoLoad) is an advantage.

Presales and Accelerator Skills

* Scoping and estimating technical engagements and defending the assumptions.

* Building proposals and presenting confidently to customer stakeholders.

* Track record of building reusable frameworks or assets that can be productized, not just one-off delivery.

AI and GenAI Skills

* Practical use of LLMs in real work, with the ability to check and validate generated output.

* Prompt design and retrieval (RAG) at a working level.

* Python or scripting for AI prototypes.

Cloud and Ecosystem

* Understand at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

* Experience with Containerized test environments is an advantage.

Nice to Have

* Experience taking an internal accelerator or product to market, including pricing or packaging.

* Exposure to enterprise ERP or regulated industry testing.

* Security testing.

* Experience with AI augmented testing tools and vector databases.

We are not looking for someone who

* Is not willing to work from the office.

* Has never worked directly with customers or in a client facing role.

* Has only manual testing experience with no hands-on automation.

* Treats AI and GenAI as buzzwords, with no real hands-on usage.

* Wants a pure delivery seat with no presales, solutioning, or customer interaction.

966514d3.description:
Job Description:

Job Description  
Position: Software Developer (.NET / SCADA Applications) – Digital Solutions  
Location: Navi Mumbai (Mahape) Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech Experience: 3-5 Years  
Role Summary  
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Software Developer with strong expertise in.NET, C#, WPF, MVVM architecture, and DevExpress controls to develop, maintain, and enhance industrial automation and SCADA-based applications. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable software solutions, integrating industrial communication protocols, and supporting mission-critical applications deployed across industrial environments. The role requires close collaboration with OT, engineering, and business teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Application Development  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using C#, .NET Framework/.NET Core, WPF, and MVVM architecture.
* Develop responsive and user-friendly SCADA interfaces using DevExpress controls.
* Implement reusable components and maintain coding standards and best practices.
* Participate in complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) activities.

2. SCADA & Industrial Integration  

* Develop and support applications interfacing with SCADA systems and field devices.
* Implement communication interfaces using industrial protocols.
* Support real-time data acquisition, monitoring, alarm management, and reporting functionalities.

3. Protocol Development & Communication  

* Work with industrial communication protocols including:

o Modbus RTU/TCP  
o OPC DA / OPC UA  
o MQTT  
o IEC 60870-5-104  
o DNP3  
o IEC 61850  
o Ethernet/IP  
o Profinet  

* Develop communication drivers, APIs, and middleware components.
* Troubleshoot communication-related issues between software and industrial devices.

4. Database & Backend Development  

* Design and optimize database structures.
* Develop stored procedures, views, and data integration services.
* Work with:

o Microsoft SQL Server  
o PostgreSQL  
o Oracle Database  

* Implement data logging, event management, and reporting solutions.

5. Software Maintenance & Support  

* Provide L2/L3 support for deployed applications.
* Perform root cause analysis and bug fixes.
* Support application upgrades, deployments, and maintenance activities.
* Maintain version control and release management processes.

6. Cybersecurity & Quality  

* Implement secure coding practices.
* Ensure compliance with industrial cybersecurity standards.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and vulnerability assessments.
* Support application hardening and user access management.

7. Documentation & Collaboration  

* Prepare technical design documents, test cases, and deployment guides.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Automation, IT, and Operations.
* Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and user training when required.
* Participate in site visits, commissioning, and customer support activities.

Required Technical Skills  
Core Development  

* Strong hands-on experience in:

General  
o C#  
o .NET Framework / .NET Core / .NET 6+  
o WPF  
o MVVM Architecture  
o XAML  
o REST APIs  
o Multithreading  
o Asynchronous Programming  
UI Development  

* Extensive experience with:

o DevExpress WPF Controls  
o Data Visualization Components  
o Dashboard and Reporting Modules  
o Custom Control Development  
Industrial Automation & SCADA  

* Knowledge of SCADA platforms such as:

o Ignition  
o WinCC  
o Wonderware  
o iFIX  
o GE Proficy  

* Understanding of: Industrial Networking

Database Technologies  

* SQL Server
* PostgreSQL
* Oracle
* Database Performance Tuning

Version Control & Tools  

* Git
* Azure DevOps
* Visual Studio
* Jira
* CI/CD Pipelines

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience in Industrial Automation, Oil & Gas, Power, Utilities, Water Treatment, or Manufacturing domains.
* Knowledge of Industrial IoT (IIoT) platforms.
* Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards.
* Exposure to Docker, Microservices, or Cloud-based industrial applications.
* Experience in commissioning or field deployment activities.

Soft Skills  

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
* Strong customer-focus and ownership mindset.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  

* Application reliability and performance.
* On-time delivery of development milestones.
* Defect resolution and MTTR.
* Successful implementation of protocol integrations.
* System uptime and customer satisfaction.
* Compliance with quality and cybersecurity standards.

f323c7bc.title: Delivery Manager - Engineering
f323c7bc.description:
**Additional Information**

What Makes You a Standout Candidate

* Thinks like an Engineering Leader and Technology Strategist, not a traditional project manager.
* Uses AI, automation, and engineering insights to accelerate delivery and improve outcomes.
* Drives measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, reliability, and business value.
* Makes data-driven decisions using engineering metrics, delivery benchmarks, and business outcomes.
* Balances technology strategy, engineering excellence, people leadership, and business priorities.
* Builds a culture of innovation, continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Successfully translates technology investments into measurable customer and business impact.

**Responsibilities**

We are seeking an experienced Delivery Manager - Engineering to lead engineering teams within the Benefits & Protection - Business Owner Solutions IT Platform organization. This role is responsible for driving delivery execution, engineering excellence, technology modernization, people leadership, and stakeholder engagement across business-critical platforms.

The successful candidate will provide leadership across engineering delivery, operational stability, talent development, performance management, and strategic technology initiatives while partnering closely with Product Management, Architecture, Operations, and Business stakeholders.

ResponsibilitiesDelivery & Execution Leadership

* Lead multiple cross-functional engineering teams delivering business-critical technology solutions.
* Drive execution of strategic initiatives, product roadmaps, modernization programs, and operational excellence objectives.
* Establish delivery governance, planning, prioritization, dependency management, release management, and risk mitigation practices.
* Ensure predictable delivery outcomes aligned with business commitments and organizational goals.
* Manage production support, operational health, service reliability, and continuous improvement programs.

Engineering & Technology Leadership

* Provide engineering leadership and technology oversight for assigned product and platform teams.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to define and execute technology strategy and modernization initiatives.
* Drive engineering excellence through adoption of best practices, automation, quality engineering, DevOps, security, and operational resiliency.
* Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment, technical debt reduction, and platform simplification efforts.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous learning, quality, and accountability.

AI & Innovation Leadership

* Lead adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices to improve development productivity, delivery velocity, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and implement AI-driven solutions that create measurable business impact.
* Promote responsible use of AI technologies, ensuring compliance, security, governance, and risk management standards.
* Drive innovation culture through experimentation, proof-of-concepts, hackathons, and emerging technology adoption.
* Leverage AI capabilities to improve software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes including requirements analysis, development, testing, documentation, knowledge management, and operational support.
* Champion engineering productivity initiatives by integrating AI-powered tools into daily delivery workflows.
* Enable teams to measure and demonstrate business value generated through AI and automation investments.

Engineering Productivity, Metrics & Outcomes

* Establish and drive engineering productivity and operational excellence metrics across teams.
* Utilize Developer Experience (DX) and Engineering Excellence frameworks to improve developer effectiveness, system reliability, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Leverage engineering insights and platform metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve value stream flow, and increase team efficiency.
* Drive adoption of data-driven decision making using engineering, delivery, quality, and operational KPIs.
* Continuously evaluate and improve team performance through actionable metrics and measurable outcomes.
* Promote automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and accelerate time-to-market.
* Establish outcome-based goals focused on customer value, business impact, delivery effectiveness, and engineering excellence.

People Leadership

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent across multiple teams.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Build high-performing, inclusive teams focused on collaboration, innovation, and customer outcomes.
* Support hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and talent acquisition activities.

Performance & Talent Management

* Own performance management processes including goal setting, development planning, talent assessments, and appraisal cycles.
* Conduct regular coaching and career development discussions with team members.
* Identify growth opportunities and create development plans aligned with organizational needs.
* Recognize and reward performance while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Business Partnership

* Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Business Leaders, Operations, and Enterprise stakeholders.
* Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, technical expertise, and business acumen.
* Align engineering initiatives with business objectives and customer outcomes.

Additional Responsibilities 

* Serve as a key BOS leadership representative within the Hyderabad location.
* Support Hyderabad location strategy, workforce growth, employee engagement, leadership visibility, and organizational development.
* Partner with local and global leaders to strengthen BOS presence and leadership effectiveness within the Hyderabad engineering organization.
* Drive local leadership forums, employee connect initiatives, and organizational health activities.

**Qualifications**

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10-14 years of technology industry experience with progressive responsibilities in software engineering, technology delivery, or engineering management.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience leading engineering teams.
* Experience leading multiple Agile delivery teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Proven experience managing performance reviews, talent development, goal setting, and employee mentoring.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple locations.
* Experience assisting with location strategy, workforce planning, and organizational growth initiatives.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams and portfolio governance forums.
* Experience managing large-scale transformation or organizational change programs.
* Solid grasp of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Developer Experience (DX) principles.
